title: 2D Floor Plan Editor for Real Estate Listings
description:
We are looking for reliable freelancers or assistants who can create clean, simple, high-quality 2D floor plans for real estate listings.



This is not architectural or engineering CAD work. We do not need construction drawings, technical documentation or exact engineering measurements.



The task is to redraw simple hand-drawn or rough floor plans into clean, readable 2D floor plans that can be uploaded to property advertisements.



These are basic real estate listing floor plans. A typical floor plan should not take more than around 20 minutes to complete. An experienced person should usually be able to create around 2–3 simple floor plans per hour.



Expected volume:



* Usually 10–20 floor plans per day

* Sometimes up to 30 floor plans per day

* This is flexible, task-based work, not a full-time job



Your task:



* Redraw hand-drawn or rough floor plans into clean 2D floor plans

* Keep the same room layout, walls, doors and windows

* Do not add extra rooms, walls, doors, windows or furniture

* Do not invent anything that is not visible on the original plan

* Create a simple and consistent style suitable for real estate advertisements

* Export the final result as PNG, JPG or PDF



Requirements:



* Good attention to detail

* Experience with simple floor plan tools, Canva, Figma, Floorplanner, RoomSketcher, AutoCAD or similar tools

* Fast and reliable delivery

* Ability to follow clear instructions

* Consistent visual quality



When applying, please send:



1. Examples of 2D floor plans you have created

2. Your price per floor plan in USD

3. How many floor plans you can complete per day

4. Which software or tool you use

5. Your usual turnaround time



We prefer a per-floor-plan price. We are looking for affordable, accurate and reliable people for recurring work. Paid test tasks may be provided before regular cooperation.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Next.js / E2B / Vercel Platforms)
description:
We're hiring a senior full-stack engineer to help us launch MythOS Pro, an AI-powered operating system for local service businesses (barbershops, salons, restaurants). It's a full platform: CRM, booking/calendar, payments, inventory, a workforce module, an AI agent (Mylo) that runs across all of it, and a website builder. You'll work directly with the founder and grow into a core engineering role as we get launch-ready. Strong English communication required.

Priority #1 — Website Builder (the immediate need):

Our builder lets a customer import their GitHub repo, edit their Next.js site inside our platform, then push to main, which triggers an automatic Vercel redeploy so their live site updates. We need this pipeline rock-solid:



Fix reliability issues with our E2B sandbox (sandboxes sometimes fail to load / dev server doesn't bind correctly on port 3000). Reference: e2b-dev/fragments.

Build a clean GitHub repo import flow: clone repo into the sandbox (sandbox.git.clone), npm install, boot the Next.js dev server, expose the preview URL into our editor iframe.

Implement edit ? commit ? push-to-main back to the customer's GitHub repo via the GitHub App (installation token).

Wire the push to trigger Vercel auto-redeploy, with each customer's site served on their own subdomain via Vercel for Platforms (multi-tenant). Help us finish setting this up.

Sandbox lifecycle management: create, auto-pause on idle, resume on edit, kill on session end, with cost controls.



Beyond the builder, there's a deep backlog across the whole platform — CRM, booking, payments integrations, inventory, the workforce module, and Mylo's agent capabilities. We want someone who can own significant pieces of the product and help drive us to launch.

Our stack:



Frontend/API surface (mythOS-pro): Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Supabase, Tailwind, deployed on Vercel.

Agent runtime (mythos-claw): a custom Rust runtime that powers our Mylo agent — built on a fork of NEAR AI's IronClaw, blended with OpenClaw, Hermes, GoClaw, and other components. Runs as a long-running service on Google Cloud Run (Postgres/Neon, Redis/Upstash, embedded Hermes worker, Gemini integration).

Other: GitHub App integration, E2B sandboxes, Vercel for Platforms (multi-tenant), Claude API, Pinecone vector search.



The two runtimes communicate over HTTP — mythOS-pro is the public-facing surface, mythos-claw is the brain.

Must have: Deep Next.js App Router + TypeScript experience and the ability to debug deployment/infra issues independently (Cloud Run, Vercel, sandboxed dev environments). Strong bonus / what sets you apart: Rust experience and comfort working in an agent runtime — we'd love someone who can contribute to mythos-claw itself, not just the Next.js surface.

title: Senior UGC Video Editor (Meta Ads) + B-Roll Sourcing + AI Generation
description:
We're a performance marketing agency running paid social for DTC brands across supplements, beauty, real estate, and lifestyle verticals. We spend serious money on Meta every month and creative is the lever that d
 whether accounts scale or stall. We're not looking for someone to just "cut videos" — we're looking for a creative partner who understands that on Meta, the editor is the media buyer's most important teammate.



We test creative aggressively. Winners get scaled, losers get killed, and we iterate weekly. The editors we love are the ones who treat every ad like a hypothesis and every variant like a data point.



THE ROLE



You'll own the post-production pipeline for multiple brands. That means taking raw UGC footage, creator deliverables, product shots, sourced B-roll, and AI-generated assets and turning them into ad variants that print money on Meta.



Three pillars to this role:



1. Editing. You can cut a UGC ad in your sleep — hooks, pacing, captions, sound design, the works.



2. Sourcing B-roll. A huge part of making UGC ads work is finding the right supporting footage. That means knowing where to pull stock clips, digging through Pinterest and TikTok for reference and inspiration, finding free-use clips on YouTube, scraping competitor ads fro
ta ad library, and knowing which clips are licensed for commercial use vs. which will get us in trouble. Half the battle is taste — knowing the exact shot that lands the message — and the other half is research speed.



3. Generating B-roll and A-roll with AI. When sourced footage doesn't exist or doesn't fit, you generate it. If we need a shot of a woman pouring coffee at 6am with golden hour lighting and the sourced clips look generic, you should be able to generate that in Higgsfield or Flow inside an hour and have it cut into the edit by end of day.



The editors who win in 2026 are the ones who can move fluidly between all three: cut creator UGC, source perfect supporting clips, and generate the impossible shots. That's what we're hiring for.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



- Editing 5–15 ad variants per week across multiple brands

- Cutting hooks (we usually test 3–5 hook variants per concept, same body)

- Pacing edits for direct response — fast cuts, motion, pattern interrupts, captioned throughout

- Sourcing B-roll from stock libraries, social platforms, and free archives — and knowing what's legally clear to use

- Building reference boards fro
ta ad library, competitor ads, and viral organic content

- Generating A-roll talking-head clips when we need spokesperson angles we don't have footage for

- Creating AI B-roll: lifestyle shots, product close-ups, transformations, before/afters, environmental context

- Building character-consistent AI footage when we're running a series or recurring "spokesperson"

- Mixing UGC creator footage with sourced clips and AI-generated supplementary footage seamlessly

- Adding captions (burned-in, branded styling), sound design, music, SFX

- Versioning ads for different placements (Reels, Feed, Stories) and aspect ratios

- Communicating async via Slack/Loom with the media buyer on what's working and what's not



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



Editing chops:

- 2+ years editing DTC/UGC ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok

- Portfolio with examples we can verify ran as paid ads (bonus if you have performance data)

- Native fluency in Premiere, CapCut, or DaVinci — we don't care which, just be fast

- Strong instinct for direct response: you know why a 0.8 second hook beats a 2 second one, you understand thumb-stop ratio, and you've watched enough Meta ad library to recognize patterns

- Caption and subtitle work that doesn't look like default CapCut

- Sound design that doesn't sound stock (royalty-free music is fine, lazy music choice is not)



B-roll sourcing skills:

- Active accounts or familiarity with Storyblocks, Artgrid, Envato, Motion Array, Pexels, Pixabay, or similar

- You know how to search efficiently — you don't burn 2 hours looking for the right clip

- You understand commercial licensing basics (what's safe, what's not, when in doubt how to verify)

- You have a system for saving and organizing reference inspiration (Pinterest boards, Notion, Eagle, Milanote — whatever works)

- You can pull fro
ta ad library and TikTok creative center to inform your edits and find inspiration footage



AI generation experience:

- Hands-on production experience with at least 2 of: Higgsfield (Soul, DoP, character training), Google Flow / Veo 3, Kling, Runway, Sora, Nano Banana

- You've solved real problems with these tools — character consistency across clips, lip sync, motion control, prompt engineering for specific aesthetics

- You understand the failure modes (warped hands, weird physics, identity drift) and how to work around them

- You have a perspective on which tool to reach for when — not just "I use whatever"



Process:

- Fast async communication

- Comfortable working from briefs, scripts, and reference ads

- Self-directed — we'll give you direction and references, but you should bring ideas

- Honest when something isn't working



BONUS POINTS



- Supplement, beauty, or health DTC experience

- You've reverse-engineered winning ads fro
ta ad library and can articulate why they work

- Familiarity with creative testing frameworks (hook-body-CTA structure, modular variants)

- You've used Higgsfield Soul for character consistency or trained custom characters

- ElevenLabs or similar AI voice work

- Motion graphics chops (After Effects, or template-based motion in CapCut)

- You follow people like Ed (Ad Burnouts), Barrett, Nick Shackelford, or have your own creative inspiration sources



LOGISTICS



- Type: Contract, with a clear path to ongoing retainer for the right person

- Hours: Start at ~15–25 hrs/week, can grow

- Location: Remote, async-friendly. Some overlap with PST hours preferred but not required

- Rate: Tell us yours. We pay competitively for editors who can actually do all three sides of this (UGC editing + B-roll sourcing + AI generation is rare — we know that)

- Tools we'll cover: AI generation tool subscriptions and stock library access if you don't already have them



HOW TO APPLY



Applications missing any of these get skipped:



1. Portfolio link — Vimeo, personal site, 
, Google Drive folder. We want to see DTC/UGC ads, not wedding videos or short films.



2. 2–3 AI-generated clips you've made — A-roll, B-roll, character work, whatever shows your range. Raw clips are fine. Tell us which tool and what the prompt/process was.



3. One ad you didn't make but love — link it and tell us in 3–4 sentences why it works. This tells us how you think.



4. Your B-roll sourcing stack — which stock libraries you have access to, where else you pull from, and your process for finding the right clip fast.



5. Your AI stack — which tools you use, which you'd reach for first, and one limitation of your favorite tool.



6. Your rate — hourly or per-edit, both fine. Be honest about where you are.



7. Availability — hours per week, time zone, when you can start.

title: Senior AI Architect
description:
Role Summary



The Senior AI Architect owns the company’s AI architecture, implementation strategy, and technical delivery standards across internal operations and client-facing systems. This role leads the execution of AI initiatives from solution design through production deployment while managing engineering quality, delivery timelines, and technical alignment across the AI team.



The role is accountable for building scalable AI infrastructure, driving implementation velocity, maintaining deployment reliability, and ensuring the AI team delivers production-ready systems that create measurable operational and commercial impact.





Key Responsibilities (Execution-Focused)

- Define and own the company’s AI architecture strategy across automation systems, AI agents, retrieval pipelines, and operational workflows

- Lead the execution of AI initiatives from discovery through deployment while enforcing delivery timelines, implementation quality, and production standards

- Manage AI engineering execution across active projects including task prioritization, architecture reviews, deployment approvals, and technical decision-making

- Establish engineering standards for AI system design, prompt management, observability, testing, deployment, and documentation

- Architect and deploy production-grade AI systems integrating LLMs, agent frameworks, vector databases, APIs, and workflow orchestration tools

- Review and validate technical implementations to ensure scalability, maintainability, security, and operational reliability before production release

- Drive weekly execution planning with AI developers and engineers to maintain delivery momentum across all implementation initiatives

- Monitor AI infrastructure performance, system uptime, response quality, latency, and operational cost and implement optimization strategies continuously

- Lead integration of AI systems into ERP, CRM, commerce, analytics, and operational platforms

- Translate business requirements into scalable technical roadmaps, implementation phases, and measurable delivery outcomes

- Deliver weekly leadership updates covering implementation progress, deployment risks, resource allocation, and AI roadmap priorities

- Identify operational inefficiencies and deploy AI automation solutions that reduce manual execution and improve business scalability

- Mentor and develop AI engineers through architecture guidance, implementation reviews, troubleshooting support, and performance accountability

- Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and deployment methodologies and integrate commercially viable solutions into the company’s AI stack



Role Requirements / Experience & Skills

- 5+ years of experience in software engineering, AI systems development, AI architecture, or technical leadership roles

- Proven experience leading AI engineering projects from architecture through production deployment

- Strong hands-on experience with Python, APIs, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and AI application development

- Experience managing engineering execution, delivery standards, and technical implementation quality across multiple projects

- Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG systems, AI agents, orchestration frameworks, vector databases, and semantic retrieval systems

- Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, or equivalent AI orchestration tooling

- Strong understanding of LLMOps, MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure monitoring, and deployment automation

- Experience integrating AI systems with ERP, CRM, commerce, analytics, and operational platforms

- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, or GCP deployment environments

- Ability to balance implementation speed, scalability, operational reliability, and infrastructure cost

- Experience creating technical standards, architecture documentation, and implementation protocols

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or related technical discipline preferred



Mindset & Execution Style

- Operates with ownership across strategy, execution, and deployment outcomes

- Leads engineering execution with clear prioritization, accountability, and measurable delivery expectations

- Makes decisions based on operational impact, scalability, deployment speed, and business value

- Maintains high technical standards while driving rapid implementation cycles

- Escalates blockers early and drives resolution without dependency-heavy management

- Enforces documentation discipline, deployment processes, and implementation consistency across the AI team

- Balances experimentation with production reliability and long-term maintainability

- Maintains strong execution focus while continuously improving systems, workflows, and team performance



Success Metrics / KPIs

- AI initiatives delivered within agreed implementation timelines and deployment milestones

- Production AI systems maintain 99%+ uptime and operational reliability

- AI engineering sprint completion and delivery targets achieved consistently

- Reduction in manual operational workload through deployed AI automation systems

- Infrastructure cost, latency, and performance maintained within defined thresholds

- Deployment quality maintained with minimal production issues or rollback incidents

- AI team implementation velocity and deployment throughput improve quarter-over-quarter



Cross-Functional Collaboration

title: Top-Tier Real Estate Cold Caller / Acquisitions Setter (US Real Estate) — Night Shift
description:
Type: Full-time or Part-time (start ~30 hrs/week, can grow)

Schedule: US business/evening hours — this is a night shift in PH time

Pay: Competitive base (USD) + uncapped per-appointment and per-deal bonuses

Location: Remote (Philippines), work-from-home



Read this whole post carefully — we only want the top 1% of callers, and the application instructions at the bottom will filter out everyone who didn't.



We're a US real estate acquisitions company that buys houses for cash nationwide. We run high-volume outbound calling every day, and the phone is what d
 whether our closers get fed or the pipeline goes dry. We're not looking for someone to just "make dials." We're looking for a phone operator who understands that the cold caller is the closer's most important teammate. Our closers have done over half a billion dollars in sales over the phone. Your job is to put motivated home sellers in front of them.



We measure everything. Callers who book appointments that show up and close get more leads, better lists, and more money. Callers who just ring dead air and clock out get cut. The setters we love treat every conversation like a live deal and every objection like a door, not a wall.



THE ROLE



You'll own the top of the funnel for our acquisitions team — calling skip-traced seller data, getting homeowners talking, uncovering real motivation, and locking qualified appointments our closers can turn into contracts.



Three pillars to this role:



1. Conversations. You can stay sharp on call 300 like you were on call 3. Rejection doesn't rattle you, volume doesn't burn you out, and you genuinely enjoy talking to strangers — because you're good at it.



2. Discovery & rapport. Anyone can read a script. You get sellers to actually open up — why they're really selling, the situation behind it, the timeline, the number in their head. You listen more than you talk and you hear what they're not saying.



3. Setting. You don't just "generate interest" — you lock the appointment. You qualify hard (motivation, equity, timeline, condition), handle the objection before it lands, and set appointments that actually show up and close. A no-show is a loss, and you know it.



The callers who win can do all three: grind the dials, build trust fast, and close for the next step.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



- Running a power dialer through skip-traced seller lists — measured on contacts and appointments set, not vanity dial counts

- Holding real conversations with US homeowners and uncovering motivation, timeline, condition, and price expectations

- Qualifying leads against our buy box — knowing a real motivated seller from a tire-kicker

- Setting qualified appointments directly onto our closers' calendars

- Handling objections and gatekeepers calmly ("I'm not interested," "what's your offer," "how'd you get my number")

- Logging every single call accurately in the CRM — if it's not logged right, it didn't happen

- Working callbacks fast — a seller who calls back is the hottest lead you'll get

- Hitting daily targets across set call windows (we manage to dials/hr, contacts/hr, and appointments set)

- Communicating with the team on Slack about what's landing and what's not



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



Phone skills:

- 2+ years of high-volume outbound — US real estate acquisitions/wholesaling strongly preferred, or hard B2C cold calling that actually converted

- Rejection-proof and high-energy through a full shift — call 300 sounds like call 3

- Excellent, clear, easy-to-understand spoken English — you're talking to US homeowners all day and they need to trust you instantly

- You sound like a human having a conversation, not someone reading a script



Sales & discovery:

- You build rapport in the first 15 seconds and get past the wall

- Real objection-handling — a calm, practiced answer to every common "no," and you know a real objection from a brush-off

- Motivation discovery — you dig for the why behind the sale and the true timeline and number

- Disciplined qualifying — you don't waste a closer's calendar on a weak lead, and you don't kill a strong one with a bad set



Setup & process (non-negotiable):

- Noise-canceling headset, a quiet home office, and reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection

- Backup power (UPS/generator) — brownouts can't take you offline mid-shift

- Comfortable on a power/predictive dialer (BatchDialer, Mojo, CallTools, or similar)

- CRM discipline — you disposition every call, accurately, in real time

- Self-directed and coachable — we give you the script, the data, and the windows; you bring the effort and the reps

- Able to work US hours (night shift in the Philippines) consistently



BONUS POINTS

- US real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, or dispo experience

- You've set appointments for high-ticket closers and understand the hand-off

- You can listen back to a call and explain exactly why it went sideways and how you'd run it again

- You study the craft — you steal from the best closers you know



PAY & GROWTH

- Base (USD) + uncapped bonuses per appointment set and per deal closed — your income scales with your results

- Start ~30 hrs/week, with a clear path to full-time and more responsibility for top performers

- We cover the dialer, the data/lists, the CRM, the scripts, and ongoing coaching



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — we skip incomplete applications)



Start your application with the word "MOTIVATED" at the very top so we know you actually read this. Applications without it get deleted.



Then send us:

1. A call recording — a real cold call or a realistic mock call, 2–5 minutes. This is the most important thing. We want to hear your tone, your discovery, and how you handle a "no." Raw audio is fine.

2. Your numbers — dials, conversations, appointments set, conversion/close rate. Be honest about where you are.

3. One appointment or deal you're proud of — 3–4 sentences on the situation and why you locked it.

4. How you'd respond to "I'm not interested" (or "just send me a cash offer") — write it exactly the way you'd say it on the phone.

5. Your setup — internet speed (run a speed test), backup internet/power, headset, dialer experience, and your work environment.

6. Your expected rate — base hourly + what you'd want per appointment set and per deal closed.

7. Availability — hours per week and the earliest you can start (confirm you can work US night-shift hours).

title: Video Editor needed for monthly YouTube creator series — motion graphics, social cuts, ongoing role
description:
Video Editor — EYE for an Idea | Monthly Creative Content Series | Ongoing Role



About the Show

EYE for an Idea is a monthly video content series powered by 
, a UAE-based creative and communications consultancy. The show spotlights the world's most clever, culturally sharp advertising, PR campaigns and creative ideas, breaking down what makes them work, why they matter, and what they mean for brands and audiences in the UAE and Middle East.



The tone is fun, fast, energetic, and personality-led. Part industry commentary, part talk show, part creative intelligence briefing. This is NOT a corporate series. It has a strong point of view and a distinct voice, and the editing needs to match that energy completely.



The show is hosted by Omar Khan, Founder of 
, with over a decade of PR and communications experience in the UAE and UK. Two episodes have already been scripted and filmed. 







What You'll Be Editing

Each episode is a focused deep-dive into one standout creative campaign or idea. The structure per episode is tight and punchy:

A fast, energetic intro

Campaign breakdown — what it is, why it works, what makes it clever

Regional relevance — what it means for UAE/Middle East audiences and brands

A closing takeaway and call to action



All filming is done by the host at home. You will not be required on set. Raw footage, the full script, and all campaign assets and references will be provided to you ahead of every edit.



Deliverables Per Episode

One full-length edited episode (5–10 minutes) optimised for YouTube

3–4 short-form social cuts optimised for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and LinkedIn

Captions/subtitles as standard throughout

Thumbnail asset for YouTube



The Editing Style

This is the most important section. Please read it carefully before applying.

We are looking for visually rich, creator-native editing. Think dynamic motion graphics, animated text overlays, sharp cuts, colour, and energy throughout. This is emphatically not B-roll with captions dropped on top. Every visual choice should serve the storytelling and amplify the host's energy.



Primary reference creators — please watch these before applying:

Cleo Abram — 

LegalEagle — 

Wendover Productions — 

Johnny Harris — 

Vox — 



The editing style sits closest to Cleo Abram — personality-led, fast, visually engaging, with graphics and animation that genuinely serve the ideas being discussed. Wendover Productions is the reference for motion graphics quality specifically.



What we do NOT want:

Corporate or broadcast-style editing

Slow dissolves or generic transitions

PowerPoint-style graphics

Over-produced effects that feel like a TV commercial

Anything formal, stiff, or "news anchor"



Important — Please Read Before Applying

No AI-generated content. We are not looking for AI-generated visuals, AI motion graphics, or automated editing workflows. We need a skilled human editor who makes real creative decisions with genuine craft and intention. If your process relies heavily on AI generation tools to produce visual content, please do not apply.

We will be trialling a small number of shortlisted editors on the first episode. This means more than one editor may work on the same brief simultaneously so we can find the right long-term fit. Payment will be made to all shortlisted candidates regardless of outcome.



Ideal Candidate

You should be able to demonstrate:

Strong experience editing creator-style YouTube content — not corporate, not broadcast

Fluency in motion graphics and animated text design (After Effects or equivalent)

Ability to maintain a consistent visual identity across a series of episodes

Understanding of short-form social media formats and platform requirements

Fast, reliable turnaround — we are building momentum and posting consistently matters

Good communication and ability to take creative direction while also contributing ideas



This is a 3-month initial trial, one episode per month, with strong potential to become more frequent and long-term as the series grows. We want to find someone who grows with the show.



To Apply

Please include:

Your portfolio — specifically YouTube creator edits and/or Reels/TikTok content

Your rate per episode (full cut + social clips)

Your typical turnaround from receiving raw footage to rough cut delivery

A brief note on which of the reference creators your editing style is closest to and why

The Social Media Manager serves as the final quality-control checkpoint before content goes live, ensuring every piece of content has the appropriate context, positioning, text hooks, captions, and calls-to-action necessary to maximize engagement and business outcomes.

This is an execution-focused role that bridges content strategy and audience interaction.

The Social Media Manager ensures content reaches the audience effectively and contributes to creator growth, authority building, partnership opportunities, and revenue generation.

Creating content alone is not enough.

Without proper publishing, optimization, engagement management, and audience interaction:

Content gets buried

Engagement opportunities are missed

Leads are lost

Growth becomes unpredictable

title: Backend Operations Manager Shopify Stores | Disputes, Supply Chain & CS (Long-Term, Full-Time)
description:
We're a fast-growing e-commerce group operating 16–30 Shopify stores across multiple legal entities. We work with a dedicated fulfillment partner (DayOne) and an external advertising agency  running Google Shopping at scale. Our volume sits at 100+ disputes per week across Shopify Payments, PayPal, and Whop, plus daily supplier coordination, customer service oversight, and agency communication via Slack.

We're not a side hustle. This is a serious operation, and we're building it like one.



What we're hiring for:

We're looking for a Backend Operations Manager — a true A-player who can take the operational weight off the founder's shoulders. You will own the day-to-day backend of the business: disputes, chargebacks, supply chain, customer service, and partner communication. If you've ever felt like you were carrying a whole company on your back and want a place that rewards that — we want to talk.



What you'll own (of course, we have teams with employees and managers in each department, but you will be ultimately responsible for all departments):



Disputes & Chargebacks (~40% of role)

* Manage 100+ disputes per week across Shopify Payments, PayPal, and Whop

* Build and execute evidence packages following our internal SOPs

* Track win rates per processor, per store, per reason code

* Identify patterns (fraud rings, recurring chargeback reasons) and flag them upstream

* Coordinate with PayPal/Stripe support when escalations are needed



Supply Chain & Supplier Coordination (~25%)

* Daily communication with our fulfillment partner (DayOne) via Slack

* Verify supplier invoices against our internal quote sheet (Empire X DayOne)

* Flag discrepancies, missing SKUs, pricing mismatches

* Track shipping issues, lost packages, returns

* Coordinate inventory questions across multiple stores/entities



Customer Service Oversight (~20%)

* Manage CS workflows across our store portfolio

* Handle escalations that frontline agents can't resolve

* Spot recurring issues and turn them into process improvements

* Keep response-time SLAs in check



Who you are

This is a backend manager role, not a VA role. We're looking for someone who:

- Has run operations for multi-store Shopify or DTC businesses before (not just one store)

- Has serious experience with PayPal disputes and Shopify Payments chargebacks at volume — you know what "compelling evidence" actually means and which arguments win

- Has worked with fulfillment partners and knows how to read an invoice critically

- Communicates in clear, professional English — written and spoken

- Lives in Slack comfortably and can hold structured conversations across multiple channels

- Is proactive — you don't wait to be told what to do, you spot problems and propose fixes

- Is calm under volume — 100+ disputes a week doesn't faze you

- Owns outcomes, not tasks



Must-haves:

- 3+ years managing operations for an e-commerce business (Shopify preferred)

- Hands-on experience defending chargebacks (Shopify Payments AND PayPal — not just one)

- Comfortable working with multiple legal entities, multiple stores, multiple payment processors

- Excellent written English

- Self-managed — full-time available, reliable internet, professional setup

- Available full-time (50 hrs/week), long-term commitment



Nice-to-haves

+ Experience with Whop disputes

+ Familiarity with Google Shopping feeds (Simprosys, Multifeeds, Pythago)

+ Experience working with external ad agencies

+ Background in fashion / branded DTC

+ Process documentation experience (writing SOPs, training others)

+ Comfort working with AI tools (we're heavily AI-augmented and will give you serious AI leverage)



What we offer:

+ Long-term, full-time role — we're hiring for years, not weeks

+ Competitive rate based on experience (range: $12–20/hr, open to higher for the right person)

+ Real ownership — you'll be the backend, not just a task-taker

+ AI leverage — we build AI agents to do the repetitive work so you can focus on judgment calls

+ Growth path — as we scale to 50+ stores and a $100M brand portfolio, this role grows with us

+ Direct access to the founder — no middle layers, no politics, no nonsense



How to apply

We get a lot of templated applications. Here's how to make sure we read yours:

Start your cover letter with the word "EMPIRE" so we know you actually read this post.

Then, in your application, briefly tell us:



- How many Shopify stores have you managed simultaneously, and which payment processors did they use?

- What's the highest dispute/chargeback volume you've handled in a single week? What was your win rate?

- Tell us about a time you caught a supplier invoice error. What was the discrepancy and how much did you save?

- What's your timezone, and what hours can you commit to overlapping with CET (Netherlands)?

- Why this role specifically — what about it fits where you want to go in the next 2–3 years?



Applications without these answers will not be reviewed.

title: Marketing & Marketplace Manager - Multi Brand
description:
Full time career opportunity – diverse B2B/B2C Marketing & Marketplace role in consumer products – growing responsibilities

A great long term career opportunity awaits a driven, agile, digital-savvy, hungry-to-learn individual who wants to take on growing responsibilities in using AI to drive digital sales and marketing for two exciting Australian consumer brands.

I own two established consumer brands (both have been around for over 50 years), historically operating in the wholesale space (800+ stockists). Over the last couple of years, the B2C channel has grown in importance and its simply too much workload for me to manage.

Your workload would consist of managing all aspects of our marketplace sale (Amazon, eBay, Iconic, Faire, Fieldfolio, Fruugo and several others) from listing products to improving discoverability and conversion. You will implement digital support projects (eg editing product images in Canva, generating AI images for digital ads, managing & optimising google ads, updating online marketplace listings on eBay, Amazon etc) as well as responding to social media posts and posting pro-actively on social media and taking initiative on broader marketing tasks. You are expected to explore how to use AI tools to make this work more efficient.

Ideally, you already have experience in digital marketplaces, consider yourself a fast learner and self-starter who is willing to take on additional responsibilities to support all sales activity through all our digital sales channels. You have a can-do attitude and are comfortable handling multiple tasks simultaneously. You are driven by success.

Advanced Microsoft office experience is required, including having previously managed online marketplaces such as eBay and Amazon. You are focussed on improving sales and have experience using tools such as Canva and AI image generation. You have capability to manage Google Ads and have some experience with AI tools such as Claude Cowork, Gemini and are keen to trial new tools in this space. Any challenges you face that are not defined by our procedures, you are willing to research yourself (eg youtube videos) to figure out how to do something.

The role is fulltime with salary increases over time in line with increased responsibilities. Hours are Monday to Friday and we honor most Filipino holidays except for All Saints and All Souls Day. Once you complete your 6 months’ probation, you are eligible for a 13th month salary.

This is a fantastic full-time career opportunity and the owner of the business is willing to invest a lot of time into your development. As such, if you are only after a short-term contract or prefer to continue doing some gig-work on the side, this role is not for you.

title: Junior Collections Officer
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Junior Collections Officer to join our finance team.



Key Responsibilities:

Develop compassionate and client-focused collections strategies to manage overdue payments effectively.

Proactively monitor accounts to identify and address overdue payments.

Work collaboratively with clients to establish manageable payment plans and resolve outstanding balances. Manage payment plans and ensure compliance with our terms.

Ensure all communications are handled with sensitivity and align with Bare’s values of empathy and transparency.

Maintain accurate records of collections activities and prepare detailed reports for management.

Stay up-to-date with relevant laws and regulations to ensure compliance with industry standards.

Collaborate with internal teams, including client support and finance, to resolve account discrepancies and improve processes.

Work with debt collectors to hand over non-responsive files

Work with our credit reporting agency partner to default non-responsive clients

Analyse data from Xero to identify trends.

Find effective ways to communicate with customers via
, letters, telephone and text

Find data trends of cohorts to prevent debts becoming bad in the first place



About You:

-Proven experience in phone support, collections management, credit control, or a similar role, ideally in a customer-centric industry.

-Exceptional communication and negotiation skills with a compassionate approach to client interactions.

-Excel/Google sheets user and able to automate tasks

-Worked with CRM tools like Hubspot

-Worked accounting systems like Xero

-Ability to analyze data and provide insights into collection trends and challenges.

-Familiarity with collections systems and financial software and credit check software and processes

-Knowledge of collections laws and regulations, with a commitment to ethical practices.

-A genuine desire to make a positive difference in the lives of clients, aligning with Bare’s mission and values.

-Australian Collection Experience is preferred but not required.



Why Work With Us?

-Be part of a purpose-driven organization that is reshaping the funeral industry.

-Competitive salary and benefits package.

-Opportunities for professional growth and career development.

-A supportive and inclusive workplace culture where empathy and innovation are valued.

-Involved in company culture building activities, flexible days leave and the opportunity to work completely remotely.



How to Apply:

If you are ready to bring your expertise to a meaningful and innovative organization, we’d love to hear from you! Submit your CV & Cover letter with your application.

At Bare Funeral Group, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences.

title: AI Video Creator Flow + Veo 3.1 + CapCut (Full-Time)
description:
What You Will Be Doing



You will be producing 10-15 short-form videos per day (25-120 seconds each) for health and wellness pages on Instagram and
.



Every morning, you receive a Google Drive folder for each reel — it includes a full production file (every image prompt, video prompt, and dialogue line already written) plus all the reference images you need. Your job is to follow it and turn it into a polished, ready-to-post vertical reel using AI tools and CapCut Pro.



This is a production role — 95% of it is execution. You do not write scripts. You do not make creative decisions about content. The only creative judgment you make is ensuring visual continuity from scene to scene — backgrounds, props, wardrobe, and prop placement should flow naturally as the video progresses. If a clip breaks continuity (wrong background, prop disappears, character looks different), you regenerate or adjust. Spotting these is the single most important skill — the difference between a video that gets 10k views and one that gets 100k.



The Video Style You Will Produce



Full Avatar + B-Roll Cuts. The AI character takes up most of the screen and speaks directly to camera. The video cuts to AI-generated b-roll 
nts at key points in the script. Captions and overlays appear throughout. This is the style used for personal, authority-building wellness content.



Each production file tells you exactly which scenes need character vs b-roll, and includes the exact image prompts and video prompts for each scene.



Tools You Need To Have (required to apply)



- Google AI Pro OR Google AI Ultra subscription

- CapCut Pro subscription



Tools I Provide (after signing)



- ElevenLabs — Generate AI voice for select reels using the cloned voice I provide (used on roughly 1 in 4 reels — the rest use the voice built into Veo 3.1)

- Veo 3.1 — Turn images into ~8 second video clips with voice

- Google Gemini Ultra account — Flow image generation + higher rate limits

- Nano Banana Pro — High-quality reference images

- Google Drive — Receive production folders, deliver finished videos



I will train you on the exact workflow for each tool. Previous experience is a plus but not required — what matters is your ability to learn fast and follow detailed instructions.



Basic Editing Skills Needed



- Stitching multiple 8-second Veo clips into one coherent video

- Spotting visual continuity breaks and fixing them

- Adding accurate captions

- Cutting dead space, tightening pacing

- Minor effects: dynamic zoom, transitions, overlays

- Attention to timing and pacing — small details separate viral content from average content



Requirements



- Active Google AI Pro or Ultra subscription (required)

- Active CapCut Pro subscription (required)

- Strong CapCut / video editing skills (you must demonstrate this in the recreate assignments below)

- Excellent English reading comprehension — production files are detailed and must be followed precisely

- Extremely detail-oriented

- Reliable, fast internet connection

- Available 6-8 hours per day, 5-6 days per week (consistency matters more than fixed hours)

- PH timezone or similar

- Can receive payments via PayPal

- Comfortable learning AI tools (I will train you, but you must be a fast and eager learner)

- Good at taking direct feedback and improving fast



Pay



- Starting: $400/month

- Performance raise: $500+/month once you are consistently producing high-quality videos at speed

- Big bonuses when content performs well ($50 per 1 million views)

- Payment via PayPal, monthly

- This is a long-term position. I am building a content network and need someone who can grow with it.



The Bigger Picture



This is my first VA hire. I am building a content network across multiple wellness brands and I need someone who can grow with me, not just clock hours.



The right person here has a clear path to:

- $1,000+/month earnings as output and quality scale

- A manager role training the next VAs I hire — once you have the workflow locked, you teach it

- Real input into how my team operates, what we systemize, what we build next



If you want a paycheck only, this is not the role for you. If you want to plant a flag and grow with an operator who is moving fast, this is rare and I will know it when I see it.



How to Apply — Two-Stage Recreate Process + Interview Call



To apply, you must complete a two-stage recreate process so I can evaluate your skills. This replaces a traditional interview — your work speaks for itself. You will use your own Google AI Pro/Ultra account and your own CapCut Pro throughout.



Stage 1 — Recreate 1: Exact Reproduction



I will send you:

- A reel from my own account

- The single reference image I used to make it



Your task: Recreate the video as exactly as you can. Match the Nano Banana Pro image generations, the cuts, the editing, and the voice. I want to see your best attempt at reverse-engineering my style.



You have 24 hours from receiving the materials to submit via Google Drive:

- The finished video (mp4)

- A Google Doc with every prompt you wrote — the image prompts AND the Veo prompts. I want to see your thinking, not just the output.

- 2-3 sentences on your process: what you noticed about the original, what was hard, what you'd improve.



This tests your ability to study a video, reverse-engineer it, and write the prompts that produce something close. This is the most important part of the application.



I will review and respond within 24-48 hours.



Stage 2 — Recreate 2: Independent Production (only if Recreate 1 is approved)



If your Recreate 1 looks strong, I will approve you to move on and send you a production file with all prompts already written.



Your task: Produce the complete video from the file. No tutorial, no walkthrough — just execute.



You have 24 hours from receiving the materials to submit via Google Drive:

- The finished video (mp4)



This tests your ability to read a production file and turn it into a polished reel — which is exactly what you will do every day in this role.



Stage 3 — The Call



If both recreates look strong, we hop on a 15 to 30-minute video call. I will walk you through my full workflow live — exactly how I produce these videos — so you understand what you are signing up for. You will have time to ask me anything and tell me why you would be a great fit. This is how I make the final decision.



To Apply, Send a Message With:



- Confirmation that you have an active Google AI Pro or Ultra subscription AND an active CapCut Pro subscription

- Your CapCut / video editing experience (specific examples, portfolio links, or a brief description of what you have edited before)

- Any experience with AI tools (Veo, Google Flow, Nano Banana, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Kling, etc.) — even minimal

- Your availability (hours per day, days per week, timezone)

- One paragraph on why you would be a great fit for this role

- Confirming you will deliver Recreate 1 within 24 hours of receiving the materials, and Recreate 2 within 24 hours of approval to move on



I will respond within 12 hours of your application with the Recreate 1 materials.



This is a production role, not a creative role. If you thrive on following clear systems, delivering consistent quality, and getting better every day, this is for you.

title: Google Ads Specialist for Shopify Store - Shopping, PMax, GMC, Simprosys & TROAS
description:
We operate a New Zealand-based Shopify eCommerce store with 400+ SKUs. Our catalogue is growing, and we are preparing to expand into Australia.



We are looking for a hands-on Google Ads specialist who understands Shopify, Google Merchant Centre, Google Shopping, Performance Max, product feeds, and TROAS bidding.



This is not a general VA role. This is also not a basic Google Ads maintenance role.



Our account currently runs mainly through one PMax campaign. Because we sell across different product categories, price tiers, and margin levels, this structure is limiting proper segmentation and scaling.



We believe the account is under-leveraged. Sales could potentially be 3-4x higher with the right structure, feed strategy, and campaign architecture.



Budget is not the main issue. Performance is.



As long as Target ROAS of 400%+ is maintained, we are open to scaling spend.



We use Simprosys for our Google Merchant Centre feed, but we have not fully used its advanced features. We want someone who can help us structure the account properly, diagnose SKU-level issues, and build a better foundation for both New Zealand growth and future Australia expansion.



Phase 1 Scope



* Full Google Ads audit

* Google Merchant Centre review

* Simprosys feed configuration review

* Feed attribute and custom label strategy

* SKU-level impression and performance analysis

* Identify underperforming product groups

* Diagnose products that should sell but are not getting traction

* Campaign segmentation strategy by category, margin, price tier, and priority

* Rebuild Google Ads campaign architecture

* Build effective PMax asset groups

* Create basic conversion-focused display creatives

* Produce simple product video assets if required

* Create a clear scaling framework for New Zealand

* Build a scalable structure for future Australia launch



We are not looking for surface-level optimisation.



We want proper Google Ads and feed architecture.



The immediate focus is Google Ads, Shopping, PMax, Merchant Centre, and Simprosys. Other channels may follow later if the work goes well.



Ideal Candidate



* Experience managing Shopify stores with 300-1000+ SKUs

* Strong Google Shopping and Performance Max experience

* Deep understanding of Google Merchant Centre

* Simprosys experience preferred

* Comfortable working with margin-based segmentation

* Understands custom labels and feed optimisation

* Able to diagnose why some SKUs get low or no impressions

* Experience expanding Google Ads accounts into additional countries is a bonus

* Data-driven, commercially minded, and able to execute without constant hand-holding



This role is not suitable if your background is mainly lead generation or Meta Ads only.



To Apply, Please Answer These Questions



1. How would you restructure a 400+ SKU Shopify store currently running mostly on a single PMax campaign?



2. How would you use custom labels in Simprosys to segment products by margin, category, price tier, and priority?



3. Why do some SKUs fail to get impressions in large catalogue Google Shopping or PMax accounts?



4. How would you scale spend while protecting a 400%+ Target ROAS?



5. Please share one measurable example where you restructured and scaled a catalogue-based eCommerce Google Ads account.



Applications that do not answer these questions will not be considered.

title: Senior Social Media Manager — High-Performance Coaching Brand (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT MIT — MILLIONAIRES IN TRAINING



MIT (Millionaires in Training) is a high-performance sales coaching brand founded by Coach Robert Villanueva — a real estate broker and sales coach with over $1 BILLION in personal sales volume and 2,500+ closed transactions. We coach real estate agents and sales professionals to become millionaires through discipline, mindset, scripts, and systems.



We are scaling fast. We have a new podcast launching, expansion into the broader sales market, and a growing community across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok,
, LinkedIn, and Skool. We are building a marketing team that will help us scale MIT to 8-figure annual revenue.



This is a real career role with a stable founder, clear leadership, and serious growth potential as MIT scales.



---



THE ROLE



You will own MIT's daily social media presence across Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, AND our Skool community. You will also manage the weekly distribution and promotion of the Millionaire Coach Podcast. You will report directly to our Marketing Director and collaborate with video editors, designers, and copywriters.



Your mission: grow our audience daily, build a thriving Skool community, drive podcast growth, and feed leads into our coaching pipeline.



---



WHAT YOU WILL OWN (DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES)



SOCIAL MEDIA:

- Schedule and publish all content across Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn, Threads, and YouTube Shorts

- Write or polish captions in MIT's brand voice (direct, disciplined, high-standard, no fluff)

- Manage Instagram and
 Stories (3–5 per day)

- Respond to all comments and DMs daily (first response within 4 hours during work hours)

- Escalate sales-qualified leads to the sales team

- Engage strategically with target accounts (real estate agents, sales pros, brokers, team leaders)

- Stay on top of trends and pitch ideas weekly



SKOOL COMMUNITY MANAGEMENT:

- Post daily to the MIT Skool community (free tier + paid tiers)

- Welcome new members within 24 hours of joining

- Drive engagement: discussion prompts, polls, weekly challenges, hot seats

- Moderate the community

- Coordinate Tier 1 and Tier 2 content drops with the Marketing Director

- Track Skool engagement metrics



PODCAST MANAGEMENT (Millionaire Coach Podcast — weekly):

- Coordinate weekly episode publishing across Spotify, Apple Podcasts, YouTube, Amazon Music

- Write show notes and episode descriptions for each episode

- Coordinate with video editor on podcast video version + short-form clips

- Schedule promotional content: 5–8 clips per episode across IG Reels, TikTok, Shorts, LinkedIn

- Publish podcast carousels and quote graphics on social

- Respond to podcast comments and reviews

- Manage podcast hosting platform (Buzzsprout, Captivate, or similar)

- Submit episodes to relevant directories



---



WEEKLY DELIVERABLES



SOCIAL MEDIA:

- 7+ Instagram Reels published

- 3+ Instagram carousels published

- Daily Instagram Stories (3–5/day)

- 7+ TikTok videos published

- 5+ LinkedIn posts published

- Daily
 posts and Stories

- 3–5 Threads posts per day

- Weekly DM and comment engagement summary



SKOOL:

- Daily Skool community posts (engagement-driving prompts, value drops, hot seats)

- Welcome message to every new member within 24 hours

- 1 weekly community challenge or discussion thread

- Weekly Skool engagement metrics report



PODCAST (Millionaire Coach Podcast):

- 1 weekly episode published across all platforms (Spotify, Apple Podcasts, YouTube, Amazon Music)

- Episode show notes + description written and published

- 5–8 short-form clips coordinated and scheduled per episode

- Podcast carousel + quote graphics published on social

- Podcast comment and review monitoring



REPORTING:

- Weekly performance report (social + Skool + podcast — top performers, flops, recommendations)



---



REQUIRED SKILLS (MUST HAVE)



- 3+ years of social media management experience (especially for coaches, consultants, agents, or service-based businesses)

- Advanced Canva skills (carousels, templates, brand consistency)

- Proficient in scheduling tools: Later, Buffer, Metricool, Publer, or Hootsuite

- Basic video editing for Stories and Reels (CapCut, InShot, or similar)

- Native-level written English with strong copywriting feel

- Deep working knowledge of Instagram, TikTok,
, LinkedIn native features

- Familiarity with Skool community management OR willingness to master it within Week 1

- Familiarity with podcast publishing workflows (Spotify, Apple Podcasts, YouTube, hosting platforms like Buzzsprout/Captivate) OR ability to learn quickly

- Analytics literacy — can read IG Insights, TikTok analytics, FB Insights and explain what the numbers mean

- Excellent attention to detail (typos are unacceptable)

- Reliable, responsive, proactive



---



BONUS SKILLS (STRONG ADVANTAGE)



- Background in real estate, sales coaching, or B2B services

- Direct experience growing a 
 community or large
 Group

- Direct experience managing weekly podcast distribution and promotion

- ManyChat or DM automation experience

- Familiarity with YouTube Shorts strategy

- Has managed social media for a coach, founder, or thought leader before

- Spanish-speaking (we are expanding into the Hispanic market — this is a real advantage)



---



WORK SCHEDULE



- Full-time, 40 hours/week, Monday–Friday

- Core hours: must overlap Pacific Time (PT) for 4–6 hours daily (example: 9 AM – 3 PM PT or equivalent in your time zone)

- Paid Filipino holidays

- 13th-month pay after 1 year of full-time work

- Long-term role — this is NOT a short-term contract or side gig



---



COMPENSATION



- Starting salary: $800–$1,200 USD/month (40 hrs/week), based on experience and skills test performance

- Performance bonuses tied to audience growth and engagement milestones

- Salary reviews every 6 months

- Paid time off after 6 months

- Long-term stability — we invest in our team



---



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- You take real pride in your work and protect a brand like it is your own

- You are a self-starter who does not need to be micromanaged

- You communicate clearly, quickly, and proactively

- You love the social media space and stay on top of trends daily

- You see this as a long-term career role — not a temporary gig

- You understand and respect a high-standard, discipline-driven brand

- You want to grow with a company that is scaling fast



---



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, send the following to 



1. Subject line: "MIT Social Media Manager — [Your Full Name]"

2. Brief intro (3–5 sentences): Who you are, why this role excites you, and what makes you the right fit

3. Portfolio: 3 examples of social media accounts you have managed (include links AND screenshots of growth or engagement metrics if available)

4. Answer this screening question: What is the first thing you would do in your first 30 days managing MIT's Instagram? Be specific — generic answers will be rejected.

5. Your full-time monthly salary expectation in USD

6. Your time zone and the specific hours you can commit to Pacific Time overlap

7. The phrase "Think Bigger" at the top of your application (we will only review applications that include this — confirms you read the post carefully)



Applications missing ANY of the above will NOT be reviewed.



---



OUR HIRING PROCESS



1. Application review — top candidates contacted within 7 days

2. Paid skills test — $25 USD for your time. You will create 3 sample IG graphics, write captions, build a content calendar, and propose a podcast promotional plan

3. Video interview — 40 minutes with our Marketing Director and Robert

4. 30-day paid trial — full salary, defined deliverables, clear performance expectations

5. Long-term offer — after successful trial, full-time long-term role with growth path



---



We are building something serious. We want someone serious. If that is you, apply today.



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



— Coach Robert Villanueva

Founder & CEO

MIT — Millionaires in Training

Think Bigger. Sell Smarter. Live Wealthier.

See you at the Top.

NextHome Valor Realty is looking for a driven, organized, and confident Real Estate Recruiting ISA to help us attract experienced, professional agents who are looking for stronger broker support, better tools, a healthier culture, and a company where they can grow.



This is a recruiting and appointment-setting role focused on quality, not just quantity. We are not looking to bring on every agent with a license. We are looking for independent, ethical, growth-minded real estate agents who want the right brokerage environment to help them build a stronger business.



The right person is comfortable making outbound calls, following up consistently, using CRM systems, having real conversations, and helping identify agents who are a strong fit for our company.



**About NextHome Valor Realty**



NextHome Valor Realty is a growing Texas real estate brokerage built around professionalism, broker support, smart tools, consumer-first service, and a Humans Over Houses culture.



We support agents with:



* Broker access and guidance

* Training and accountability

* Modern marketing tools

* CRM and technology support

* Lead generation strategies

* A professional, collaborative culture

* A company brand that stands for people first



**About the Role**



The Recruiting ISA will be responsible for identifying, contacting, nurturing, and setting appointments with licensed real estate agents who may be a good fit for NextHome Valor Realty.



This role requires strong communication skills, excellent follow-up habits, confidence on the phone, and the ability to build trust quickly.



You will be expected to work from a recruiting database, make outbound calls, send texts and
s, track conversations, update the CRM, and schedule qualified recruiting appointments with the broker.



**Primary Responsibilities**



* Make outbound recruiting calls to licensed real estate agents

* Identify agents who may be looking for better broker support, tools, training, accountability, or company culture

* Set qualified recruiting appointments with the broker

* Follow up consistently by phone, text, and

* Track all conversations, notes, follow-ups, and appointment outcomes in the CRM

* Help maintain and organize the recruiting database

* Use scripts and talking points while still sounding natural and conversational

* Pre-qualify agents based on production, professionalism, goals, attitude, and brokerage fit

* Research agents, brokerages, production history, and local market activity when needed

* Help create and improve recruiting follow-up campaigns

* Send recruiting
s, texts, and meeting reminders

* Confirm appointments and help reduce no-shows

* Provide weekly reporting on calls, conversations, appointments set, appointments held, and agent recruiting pipeline

* Communicate regularly with the broker regarding strong prospects, concerns, and follow-up priorities



**The Ideal Candidate**



You are someone who:



* Is confident making outbound calls

* Has strong spoken and written English

* Can build rapport without sounding pushy or robotic

* Understands that recruiting is follow-up, follow-up, and more follow-up

* Is organized and consistent

* Can handle rejection without taking it personally

* Knows how to ask good questions and listen for motivation

* Can spot quality candidates instead of chasing anyone with a license

* Works independently and takes ownership of results

* Is comfortable with performance-based pay

* Wants to grow with a small but ambitious brokerage



**Required Skills**



* Prior experience in real estate, recruiting, inside sales, appointment setting, or outbound calling

* Strong phone skills and professional communication

* Excellent English speaking and writing ability

* Ability to work Texas Central Time business hours

* Experience using a CRM

* Comfortable with
, texting, Google Workspace, Zoom, and basic online research

* Reliable internet, quiet workspace, headset, webcam, and ability to make outbound calls to the U.S.

* Strong follow-up and organizational skills

* Ability to follow scripts, track activity, and report results



**Preferred Experience**



* Real estate recruiting experience

* Experience calling real estate agents

* Familiarity with BoldTrail, kvCORE, Follow Up Boss, LionDesk, or similar CRM systems

* Experience with Google Sheets, Google Drive, Gmail, and basic reporting

* Knowledge of brokerage models, agent splits, caps, training, lead generation, and agent pain points

* Experience setting appointments for high-level sales conversations



**Compensation**



This position includes a small base salary plus performance-based bonuses.



The compensation plan is designed to reward results, especially quality appointments and agents who successfully join and stay with the brokerage.



Potential bonus opportunities may include:



* Bonus for qualified recruiting appointments set

* Higher bonus for appointments that are held

* Bonus for agents who affiliate with the brokerage

* Additional bonus after recruited agents remain with the brokerage for a set period

* Possible long-term growth incentives as the recruiting system expands



This is not a high-base, low-accountability position. The right person will be motivated by performance and rewarded for producing real results.



**What Counts as a Qualified Recruiting Appointment**



A qualified appointment means the agent:



* Is currently licensed or actively working toward licensure

* Is located in or willing to serve the markets we support

* Has a professional attitude and communication style

* Is open to a brokerage conversation

* Has a reason to consider a move or is looking for stronger support

* Is not simply looking for the lowest split with no engagement

* Understands the appointment is with the broker to discuss brokerage fit



**This Role Is Not a Fit If You:**



* Are afraid to make outbound calls

* Give up after one follow-up attempt

* Need constant supervision

* Are disorganized with notes and CRM updates

* Sound scripted or overly aggressive

* Focus only on volume instead of quality

* Cannot work Texas Central Time hours

* Are uncomfortable being paid based on performance



**How to Apply**



Please send:



1. Your resume

2. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your recruiting, sales, or appointment-setting experience

3. A brief summary of your real estate experience, if any

4. Your experience with CRM systems and Google Workspace

5. Your DISC assessment results: https://www.tonyrobbins.com/disc/

6. Include the phrase **“Quality Agents Matter”** in your application so I know you read the full post



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



We are building a brokerage for agents who want support, tools, professionalism, and a broker who is engaged in their success. If you are organized, confident on the phone, and motivated by results, this could be a strong opportunity.

title: YouTube Scriptwriter - Gaming Channel
description:
About Us



We are a U.S.-based esports-tech company behind Hawk Live - a leading Dota 2 live score platform with 4M+ monthly visits from gamers worldwide.



We are also the team behind Hawk Live Gaming, a fast-growing YouTube channel launched in 2025 that already generates 1M+ views per month. Multiple videos have crossed 500K views, and the channel continues to grow rapidly. We know how to ship content that performs.



Now we’re building a dedicated production team to scale even faster.





What You’ll Do



1) Research, outline, and write 4 scripts per month (30-65 minutes each) for YouTube videos about:



AI experiments in games: testing whether AI models (ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, etc.) can create builds, strategies, or even beat games like Elden Ring, including AI vs AI challenges, AI vs humans, and validating the results through real gameplay and boss fights.



Elden Ring: builds, progression strategies, damage scaling, stat breakpoints, and objective testing to determine the strongest setups.



Souls-like and similar RPGs: quickly analyzing popular titles and understanding their build systems, mechanics, and optimization strategies.



Strong candidates are welcome to suggest video ideas and experiment concepts.



2) Capture your own 1080p (or better) gameplay footage: progression, boss fights, weapon tests, damage benchmarks, etc.



3) Present clear shot lists and time codes for the video editor.



4) Use basic algebra and spreadsheets to calculate DPS, stat breakpoints, soft caps, etc.



5) Collaborate with the channel manager and video editor.





Requirements



1) Portfolio: at least 2 published gaming YouTube scripts or videos where you were the primary scriptwriter, demonstrating strong pacing, audience psychology, and long-form retention.



2) Strong understanding of YouTube’s platform and trends, with high taste in the economics and finance niche - you actively watch long-form economics content and understand what drives retention and watch time.



3) Familiarity with modern AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.) and curiosity about using them to design experiments, strategies, or ideas that can be tested in gameplay.



4) Capable PC and recording setup to produce smooth, artifact?free gameplay clips.



5) Proven ability to brief video editors (visual references, pacing notes, etc) so the final cut matches your vision.



6) Comfort with basic algebra / spreadsheets for DPS calculations, stat breakpoints, and progression math.



7) Fluent written English with natural wording, tone, and contemporary U.S. cultural references (no AI-translated text; grammar and punctuation must read naturally to a U.S. audience).



8) Ability to work independently, accept feedback, and iterate quickly.



9) Ability to deliver each complete script within 5 business days of receiving the brief, including revisions and gameplay footage.



10) No AI-generated scripts. All writing must be original and human-written. We may use plagiarism/AI screening and will ask you to confirm authorship.





What We Offer



Flexible, fully remote contract (engagement and payments via 
; we cover all platform fees)



Stable workload: 4 scripts each month



Clear briefs, fast feedback, and a creative team that respects deadlines



Potential to step into Lead Content Strategist as we scale



Paid bonuses for exceptional performance





Pay:



$800 USD/month, with performance-based raises as the channel grows.





Benefits



Flexible schedule



Pay raises as we grow



Performance bonuses



Work from home





How to Apply



Please send your resume, at least 2 YouTube script samples, and links to gameplay footage you recorded yourself. Applications without script or footage samples will not be considered.



We’re reviewing applications daily and hiring as soon as we find the right fit. If you meet the criteria - apply now.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Executive Virtual Assistant to serve as the right-hand operator for two growing businesses: a successful YouTube channel and a Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) company. This is not a passive support role. You will be deeply involved in day-to-day operations, and your attention to detail and communication skills will directly impact the quality and success of both businesses.

If you take pride in doing things right, communicate clearly and promptly, and genuinely enjoy keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes, we want to hear from you.





YouTube Channel Responsibilities

Thoroughly review all video content before publication, catching grammar, spelling, and numerical errors with a critical eye

Create YouTube Shorts from existing long-form video content

Upload videos to YouTube Studio and optimize with SEO-driven titles, descriptions, and tags (training provided; prior experience is a strong plus)

Communicate regularly with video editors and the thumbnail designer to coordinate timely delivery and quality

Maintain organized spreadsheets to track video production status, uploads, and performance

Social Media posting





Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Company Responsibilities

Communicate professionally with clients and internal tea
mbers on behalf of the company

Invoice medical offices and manage related follow-up

Assist with general operations and administrative tasks as needed





Executive and Personal Assistance

Manage the owner's schedule, appointments, and calendar with precision

Coordinate travel arrangements and logistics

Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external communications

Anticipate needs and proactively handle tasks before being asked





Tools and Communication

We primarily work within Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Drive). Familiarity with YouTube Studio, CapCut or similar short-form video tools, and project tracking spreadsheets is helpful. You should be comfortable communicating via
 and messaging platforms (WhatsApp or Slack). We expect responses within a reasonable window during working hours and ask that you be available for overlap with US Central Time.



Who You Are

Exceptionally organized and nothing falls through the cracks

A strong command of the English language, including grammar, spelling, and clear professional writing

A proactive, responsive communicator who follows up without being asked

Comfortable working independently and managing multiple priorities at once

Tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools and platforms

Interested in a long-term role with room to grow as the businesses grow

Prior experience with YouTube, video production workflows, or healthcare RCM is a significant advantage





Compensation and Details

Starting pay: $7.00 USD per hour

Bonus opportunities based on performance and contribution

Full-time position

Some flexibility with hours; we value reliability and results

Long-term opportunity with real potential for growth





How to Apply

Please read the instructions below carefully and answer every question in your application. We review all responses personally. Applications that skip questions or provide incomplete answers will not be considered.



To help us identify candidates who read carefully, please begin your application message with the phrase: "Detail First" at the very top.



Application Questions

Please answer all five questions. Thoughtful, specific answers matter far more than length.



Question 1: About You



Tell us something specific about yourself. What is one of your favorite hobbies, and what do you enjoy most about it?



Question 2: Research and Accuracy



Please look up the address of Sweetwaters Coffee and Tea in Naperville, IL and write it below exactly as it appears, including the suite number and zip code.



Question 3: Proofreading



Read the paragraph below carefully and list every error you find, including grammar, spelling, punctuation, and factual inconsistencies. Describe each error and explain what the correction should be.



"The meeting was schedueled for Febuary 31st at 3:00 AM in the afternoon. Their were five clients in attendence, and each of them have recieved the invoice on March 30th. The total amount due were $12,50.18  and the dead line for payment is in 10 days from the meeting."



There are multiple errors in this paragraph. List each one separately.



Question 4: Professional Rewrite



Rewrite the following sentence so that it is clear, professional, and grammatically correct. Do not change the meaning.

"hey so i wanted to let u know that the video wasnt uploaded yet and i think maybe the editor forgot or something and it was supposed to go up yesterday."



Question 5: Following Instructions



You have been asked to send an invoice to a medical office. The invoice total is $3,750.00, the due date is 30 days from today, and the contact name is Dr. Patricia Reynolds. Write a brief, professional
 you would send to deliver this invoice. Use today's date.





We look forward to hearing from someone who takes pride in doing things right.
