title: Part-Time Premiere Pro Editor
description:
Part-Time Premiere Pro Editor — Corporate Safety Training Videos

** I invite GIG workers to apply too - we can figure out a rate that works for both of us**

Revised: May 2026

Skills Required

Adobe Premiere Pro (required)

Microsoft PowerPoint (required)

Basic Dropbox file management (required)

Good written English communication (required)

Adobe After Effects — nice to have, not required

 

About Acclai
dia

Acclai
dia is a U.S.-based corporate video production company serving manufacturers, service firms, and B2B businesses since 1998. We produce safety, training, marketing, and corporate videos for clients across the Midwest and beyond. Learn more at www.acclai
.



About This Role — Please Read Carefully

We believe in being straightforward about what this job is, what it could become, and what we can honestly promise. Please read this section before applying.

 

This role begins as a defined project: converting approximately 40 corporate safety training PowerPoint presentations into professional video modules for a U.S. safety consulting client — in both English and many in Spanish.

We are not promising this is a permanent full-time position. What we can honestly commit to is this:

A genuine intention to grow this into an ongoing part-time relationship as new client projects come in

Fair, consistent pay with performance-based increases — not a one-time gig rate

 

We are building a production team, not filling a temporary slot. The right person will have the opportunity to grow with Acclai
dia into long-form corporate video, social media edits, marketing videos, testimonials, and more. But we want to earn that relationship over time — not promise it before we've worked together.



About the Project

Our client has a library of 40 corporate safety training PowerPoint presentations. Each will be converted into a professional English video module and a matching Spanish version.

For each video, Acclai
dia will provide you with:

English PowerPoint slides

English AI voiceover audio

Spanish AI voiceover audio

Approved Spanish text translations for all slides

Premiere Pro project template

Dropbox folder structure and file naming guide

Google Sheet project tracker

 

You will deliver:

Completed English Premiere Pro timeline

Completed Spanish Premiere Pro timeline

Spanish PowerPoint file with approved translations placed into slides

Updated Google Sheet status report

 

We handle final video exports on our end. You upload project files to Dropbox.

Note: All Spanish translations are provided to you pre-approved. You are placing approved text into slides — not translating. Do not alter the approved Spanish text.

 

Main Responsibilities

Build English training video timelines in Premiere Pro using provided slides and voiceover

Build Spanish training video timelines using provided Spanish slides and Spanish voiceover

Replace English slide text with approved Spanish translations in PowerPoint

Follow the provided Premiere Pro template exactly

Follow Dropbox folder and file naming conventions exactly

Update the Google Sheet tracker after each work session

Send a brief end-of-shift update after every session

 

Work Schedule

This is a part-time role at approximately 24 hours per week.

We strongly prefer candidates who work 4–5 hours daily rather than 8-hour block sessions. This work requires sustained attention to detail — long single sessions increase the risk of errors in file naming, slide accuracy, and timeline organization. Shorter daily sessions keep the work sharp and give both of us better visibility into progress.

 



Compensation

Pay range: $525 USD per month, depending on Premiere Pro skill, PowerPoint accuracy, English communication, and overall experience.

The compensation structure works as follows:

60-day trial period: $525/month — real production work, real pay

Post-trial confirmed rate: $550/month — awarded after a successful 60-day review



At the end of every work session, send a short update:

What I completed today

Problems or questions

Goal for next session

Hours worked

Files uploaded to Dropbox

 

Good communication is required. If you get stuck, ask. Do not disappear.

This May Not Be a Good Fit If...

You need creative freedom — this work is process-driven and repetitive

You need guaranteed full-time hours from day one

You dislike detailed file organization and naming conventions

You disappear when stuck rather than asking a clear question

You need constant instruction rather than working from a provided template

 

How to Apply

Please read this entire post before applying. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

In the first sentence of your reply, include the phrase: orange safety cone

Tell me why this project is a good fit for you.

Send links to 2–3 video samples. For each, tell me exactly what you did.

If you have long-form, social media, corporate, training, or testimonial samples, include them — they help us find more ways to work together.

Attach or link your resume as a PDF.

Confirm you have Adobe Premiere Pro and Microsoft PowerPoint.

Record a 1-minute Loom video introducing yourself. Answer these questions:



What other types of video editing could you help Acclai
dia with in the future?



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph only. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the paid production test.



Client looking to begin shortly, if interested apply quickly so we can get a good candidate and start.

title: Bookkeeping and General Admin VA - Tradify exp for AUS electrical business
description:
About the Role

This is a part-time virtual assistant role supporting a fast-moving, growth-focused electrical business in South East Queensland. The business is a one-director operation with the owner currently managing all back-of-house administration alongside full-time field work — and that's not sustainable as the business scales.



You'll step in as the operational and financial right hand to the Director, taking ownership of daily bookkeeping, Xero reconciliation, Tradify job management, inbox triage, and quoting support. The goal is to free the Director to focus on growing the business into specialist commercial work — smart home automation, security and CCTV, data services — without the back office falling behind.



This is not a task-ticker role. The right person will create tasks, flag issues before being asked, and take real ownership of their scope. If you wait to be told what to do, this isn't the right fit.



Role Details

Employment Type: Part-Time Virtual Assistant (can grow to full time)

Hours Per Week: 20 hours

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Preferred Hours: Afternoon shift — approx. 12:00pm–4:00pm AEST (flexible, to be confirmed)



Key Responsibilities

Financial Management & Bookkeeping

Reconcile accounts in Xero and flag any discrepancies

Import expense data from CSV files and e-invoices into Tradify and Xero

Ensure financial data across Tradify and Xero is aligned

Prepare data in a clean, organised state ready for the external bookkeeper's BAS compliance review

Monitor payment due dates and flag upcoming obligations

Track outstanding invoices and follow up as directed

Support cash flow visibility — surfacing when invoices should be sent and when payments are due



Tradify Job & Platform Management

Conduct an initial Tradify cleanup: audit active jobs and close out completed jobs not yet marked as done

Ensure all job statuses accurately reflect reality — completed, in-progress, invoiced, closed

Identify gaps in how the platform is currently being used

Monitor job progress and flag anything that looks unusual or incomplete

Generate and interpret Tradify productivity reports to surface which jobs are profitable and which are not



Quoting & Pricing Support

Obtain updated CSV price lists from the wholesaler each month and update prices in Tradify

Cross-check product numbers and pricing via the wholesaler's online portal

Format quotes based on notes and information provided by the Director

Ensure all quotes reflect current material costs after each price list update

Build and maintain standard quote templates and item codes in Tradify over time

Draft quote follow-up communications as directed



Inbox & Communication Management

Triage the Director's inbox daily: sort, prioritise, and flag what needs attention

Review sent inbox during onboarding to understand communication style and tone

Draft
 responses on routine inquiries for Director review before sending

Send quote follow-up
s initially as drafts in Gmail for approval



Daily Communication & Task Management

Send a morning WhatsApp message with priorities for the day

Send an end-of-day
 report: tasks completed, work in progress, items requiring Director's attention (CC: Workspaceco)

Set up and maintain the Asana task board for daily, weekly, and monthly task cadence

Capture ad hoc tasks and instructions from voice notes and messages; log in Asana



Operational & Administrative Support

Assist with scheduling and diary management as needed

Document processes and create SOPs as tasks are handed over in real time — not batched at the end of the week

Ad hoc tasks as directed by the Director



What We're Looking For

Experience & Background

Strong bookkeeping background with hands-on Australian client experience

Familiarity with Australian tax obligations: BAS, IAS, GST, and payroll

Prior experience working in a trades or construction business strongly preferred

Comfortable working as the right hand to a sole director in an autonomous, self-directed capacity



Technical Skills

Xero: mandatory — strong working proficiency required

Tradify: prior experience strongly preferred; demonstrated ability to learn quickly if not

Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Meet): required

Asana: basic proficiency or willingness to learn quickly

Comfortable navigating online product portals for pricing and availability checks

CSV data imports and price list management: advantageous

AI tool fluency: experience using Claude, Gemini, or similar tools as a genuine productivity multiplier

WhatsApp and Fathom: comfortable with messaging platforms and basic note tools



Analytical & Financial Skills

Can identify anomalies and variances in financial data without being prompted

Understands job-based financials: tracking costs against quotes, flagging overruns, spotting unprofitable patterns

Comfortable generating and interpreting productivity and profitability reports

Confident working with CSV files and price list data



Communication & Independence

Strong written and verbal English — will draft client-facing
s and communicate with the Director daily

Proactive communicator: sends morning priorities, asks the right questions, flags issues early

Comfortable working from voice notes and informal instructions; can extract action items from a brain dump

Captures tasks in real time without needing to be asked



The Ideal Candidate

Beyond skills and systems, we are looking for someone with a specific way of working. The Director moves fast, thinks out loud, and expects people to keep up — not get flustered.



Proactively autonomous: works through the task list, surfaces what is coming, communicates progress without being chased

Detail-obsessed: catches the invoice with the wrong price, the job marked complete but not invoiced, the payment due in two days

Analytical: goes beyond processing tasks to interpreting them — spots patterns, asks why when something doesn't look right

Fast learner: picks up new platforms and systems without extensive handholding; asks the right questions instead of waiting for a full tutorial

Calm under pressure: can keep up with a fast-moving director, extract clear action items from a voice note, and stay organised without getting flustered

Systems builder: naturally documents what they do and sees SOPs as a useful business tool, not a tick-box exercise

Commercially aware: understands the numbers they manage represent real cash flow and real business consequences

Reliable under routine: handles repetitive tasks — reconciliation, inbox triage, price list updates — with consistent accuracy

Comfortable with ambiguity: not everything is documented yet; can work in that space and help build the structure rather than wait for it

Discreet and trustworthy: will have access to sensitive financial data and business information; this is non-negotiable

title: Customer Service Representative

s, resolving issues, answering order questions, reducing refund requests, and making sure customers feel looked after.

 and written communication only.



About the Role



We need a customer service agent who is not just “nice,” but effective.



You must be able to think clearly, solve problems fast, communicate professionally, and protect the business while still giving customers a great experience. The goal is to reduce refunds, prevent chargebacks, calm frustrated customers, and handle daily support without needing constant supervision.



You will be responsible for managing customer enquiries, tracking updates, order issues, refund requests, replacement requests, delivery delays, product questions, and general store support.



Key Responsibilities

Answer customer
s professionally and quickly

Handle order questions, delivery updates, and tracking enquiries

Resolve customer complaints before they become refunds or chargebacks

Reduce refund requests by offering helpful solutions

Communicating with our supplier to ask questions regarding customer inquiries     

Communicate clearly with customers in fluent English

Escalate only the issues that genuinely need founder attention

Keep support organized and make sure no customer is ignored

WE DO NOT WANT TO BE GIVING OUT REFUNDS 

Help improve customer service templates and processes over time

Maintain a calm, professional tone even with difficult customers



Requirements

Minimum 2 years of ecommerce customer service experience

Must provide proof of previous experience

Strong written English is required

Experience handling refunds, complaints, shipping delays, and order issues

Must have a proven track record in reducing customer complaints, refunds, or support workload

Must be reliable, organized, and able to work independently

Must be confident dealing with frustrated customers

Must be able to follow policies and make smart decisions

Experience with Shopify is strongly preferred

Experience with Gmail, order tracking tools, or ecommerce platforms is a plus



The Person We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is tough, switched on, and solution-focused.

title: Influencer & UGC Marketing
description:
Part-time to start with, goal to expand full-time. We're hiring an Influencer & UGC Marketing Manager to build and run our creator seeding program from the ground up. You'll start by focusing on TikTok Shop, recruiting and seeding the right creators, getting product into their hands, and turning that into a steady stream of high-converting content. Once that engine is humming, you'll expand the playbook to Instagram, YouTube, and beyond.



This is a builder role. You're not inheriting a polished program; you're creating one. If you love finding under-the-radar creators before they blow up, negotiating smart deals, and watching a piece of content take off, this is for you.



Our audience is men aged 18–35 who care about style, ambition, and standing out. You need to know how to find creators who actually speak to that guy.



What You'll Do



Build the TikTok Shop seeding program end to end: sourcing, outreach, gifting, affiliate setup, and ongoing creator relationships

Find high-quality creators who match our brand and audience — separating real influence from inflated follower counts

Recruit and brief UGC creators who can produce scroll-stopping, authentic video content that converts (not just pretty content)

Manage seeding logistics — outreach pipelines, product fulfillment to creators, tracking, and follow-up at scale

Negotiate partnerships across gifted, affiliate/commission, and paid collaborations

Expand to new channels — port the seeding playbook to Instagram, YouTube, and emerging platforms as we grow

Track performance — measure content output, engagement, sales attribution, and ROI; double down on what works

Source and curate the best UGC for use in our paid ads and organic channels



What We're Looking For



- 2+ years running influencer seeding, creator partnerships, or UGC programs — ideally for a DTC / e-commerce brand

- Proven TikTok Shop experience (or a strong, demonstrable understanding of how TikTok Shop seeding and affiliate programs work)

- A sharp eye for talent — you can spot a creator who'll produce great content and drive sales, not just rack up vanity metrics

- Experience managing UGC creators and briefing them to produce high-performing video content

- Strong outreach and relationship skills — you can DM a creator and get a yes

- Organized and systems-minded — you can run hundreds of creator relationships without dropping balls

- Comfortable with performance data and using it to make decisions

- Bonus: experience in men's fashion, jewelry, grooming, fitness, or lifestyle verticals



Nice to Have



An existing network of creators in our space

Familiarity with seeding/affiliate tools (e.g., affiliate platforms, creator CRMs)

Experience scaling a program across multiple platforms

A genuine interest in our brand and the men we serve



How to Apply



Send us:



- A short note on why this role and a creator program (or campaign) you're proud of

- 2–3 examples of creators or UGC content you sourced that performed well

- Your resume or LinkedIn

title: Whop Community & Content Rewards Manager
description:
Overview



We are seeking a dedicated manager to build and oversee our Whop Content Rewards program. Your mission is to grow our reach by connecting with clippers—creators who repurpose our content—and paying them on a per?view basis through Whop’s built?in system. This role is separate from content creation and social?media management; your focus is on platform setup, creator recruitment, and program administration.



Whop’s Content Rewards allows brands to upload shareable content, set a payment rate per 1?000 views, and connect with creators who distribute that content . Brands d
 how much to pay per view and only pay for actual views received .



Responsibilities



* Set up and maintain a Whop account:

    * Create or manage a Whop business account (free and easy to set up ).

    * Add the Content Rewards app within the Whop dashboard .

* Configure and fund campaigns:

    * Set payment rates per 1?000 views to stay within budget and attract clippers .

    * Ensure funds are available and track spend versus performance.

* Upload and curate content:

    * Work with our creative team to upload videos, demos, or behind?the?scenes clips that are share?worthy .

    * Maintain an organized library of content for clipping.

* Recruit and manage clippers:

    * Identify and select creators who align with our brand; Whop’s platform helps match brands with suitable clippers .

    * Approve submissions and provide feedback to ensure quality and brand alignment.

* Monitor performance:

    * Track views, engagement, and cost per view via Whop’s real?time dashboard .

    * Produce weekly reports summarizing campaign results and insights.

* Community engagement:

    * Communicate with clippers, answer questions, and foster a positive community atmosphere.

    * Stay informed about updates to Whop and industry best practices.



Requirements



* Experience with social media or creator platforms, preferably with user?generated?content programs.

* Strong organizational and communication skills; ability to juggle multiple campaigns and creators.

* Comfort managing budgets and payouts; familiarity with pay?per?view or affiliate?style marketing is a plus.

* Tech?savvy: able to navigate platforms like Whop and learn new tools quickly.

* Self?starter who can operate independently and report results concisely.



Nice?to?Haves



* Prior experience recruiting or managing influencers or creators.

* Familiarity with short?form video trends and what makes content clip?worthy.

* Understanding of marketing analytics and performance metrics.



Compensation



* Hourly Rate: $5–$7 per hour (negotiable based on experience).

* Hours: 15–25 hours per week (flexible, depending on campaign volume).



Application Questions



1. Describe your experience with user?generated content or influencer marketing platforms.

2. Have you managed pay?per?view or affiliate campaigns before? If so, what tools did you use and what were the results?

3. How would you ensure that uploaded content is appealing and “share?worthy” for potential clippers?

4. How do you stay organized while managing multiple creators and budgets?

title: Customer Service Specialist / Virtual Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Specialist / Virtual Service Advisor

Automotive Support. Full training provided. No car experience needed

Company: WorkWise Auto Solutions PTY LTD

Location: Remote Set-Up



About WorkWise Auto Solutions



WorkWise Auto Solutions is transforming how automotive workshops operate. We help shop owners streamline their workflow, reduce administrative stress, and increase profitability through a combination of smart systems and human support.

Our core service revolves around Virtual Service Advisors (VSAs) who handle customer communication, booking triage, job approvals, and workflow optimisation. We also build internal tools, marketing assets, and client-facing platforms to support that mission, and that’s where you come in.



You do not need to know anything about cars. We will train you fully.



A Virtual Service Advisor (VSA) is the organised, friendly engine room of an Australian auto workshop. You are the calm voice that their customers talk to, and the person quietly keeping the day on track behind the scenes by booking jobs, sorting parts, preparing quotes and invoices, and making sure nothing slips through the cracks.

It is about a third customer conversation and two-thirds careful, methodical follow-through inside the workshop's systems. We will teach you every tool. What we cannot teach is the mix we are really after: warmth with people, and the kind of mind that closes every loop.



Is this you?

 - You communicate clearly and warmly in English, in writing and on a call.

 - You stay calm and helpful when someone is annoyed, confused, or in a hurry.

 - You close the loop. If you order a part, you track it until it arrives. Nothing gets forgotten.

 - You are comfortable living inside software all day and learning new systems quickly.

 - You can juggle lots of small tasks accurately, under a bit of pressure, without dropping any.

 - You want a long-term, stable role, not a quick gig.

If that sounds like you, we would genuinely love to meet you, automotive background or not.



What you'll do day to day

 - Triage incoming enquiries and manage the workshop's diary and daily capacity.

 - Source, quote, order, and follow up with suppliers, and chase ETAs.

 - Prepare estimates and quotes, and send them to customers.

 - Build and organise job cards and bookings in the workshop's system.

 - Finalise jobs by tidying the details, raising invoices, and sending payment links.

 - Handle customer messages, voi
s, and work approvals warmly and promptly.

 - Own your day with a quick morning plan, a heads-up at lunch, and a clear end-of-day wrap.



Two real 
nts from the role: 

   -  The upset customer

          "A customer was promised their car by 3 pm. It is 2:30 and the part has not arrived. They message upset, because they need the car for work tomorrow. How do you handle that conversation?"

     - The part that didn't show

          "You ordered a part three days ago and the customer is booked in tomorrow morning. It still has not arrived and the supplier has not updated you. What do you do today, not tomorrow?"



If you already have an instinct for both of these, calm and honest with the customer, and proactive and a step ahead on the parts, you will do well here. That instinct matters to us more than a polished resume.



Why you'll like it here

 - Full on-the-job training. No automotive knowledge required to start.

 - 100% remote. Work from anywhere in the Philippines.

 - Australian day-shift hours, so your evenings and family time stay yours.

 - Real growth. Many of our team have moved into senior and specialist roles.

 - A supportive team that values clear communication and genuine care for clients.





How to apply

Applications are only reviewed through the form below, not via
 or this post.

Apply here:  
  

Select “Virtual Service Advisor” as the position.



Two things we read first, so please don't skip them:

1. In your short intro video, pick either scenario above and talk us through exactly what you would do.

2. Tell us about one time you stayed on top of a messy, multi-step task and made sure nothing slipped.

Generic, recycled VA applications get filtered out. We are looking for the person behind the answers.

title: B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for U.S. Local Businesses
description:
# B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter for U.S. Local Businesses



## Job Overview



We are hiring a B2B cold caller / appointment setter to call local businesses in the United States and book qualified appointments with business owners.



We work with plumbing and home service businesses. Our service helps these businesses capture missed and after-hours calls so they can book more jobs instead of losing leads to voi
 or slow follow-up.



Your job is to call business owners, ask simple qualification questions, and book appointments for our closer.



You are not responsible for closing the sale. Your job is to set quality appointments with interested business owners.



## Compensation



This role includes guaranteed hourly pay plus performance bonuses.



Paid trial:



**$3 USD per hour for the first 10 hours**



After successful trial:



**$4 USD per hour**



Performance bonuses:



**$12.5 USD for every qualified appointment that shows up**

**$50 USD for every appointment that becomes a closed, paid client**



A closed, paid client means the business owner attends the appointment, signs the agreement, and pays the first invoice.



Bonuses are paid after the appointment shows or after the client’s first payment is received.



## Daily Call Expectations



Expected ramp-up:



**Training period:** 75–100 dials per day

**Week 1:** 100–150 dials per day

**Week 2:** 150–200 dials per day

**Experienced target:** 200–300 dials per day depending on shift length and call quality



All calls must be made through our CRM/calling system so activity can be tracked.



Calls made outside the CRM will not count.



## Main Performance Goal



The main goal is to book qualified appointments with business owners.



A realistic target is:



**3–5 qualified appointments per week once fully trained**



Quality matters more than fake volume. We do not want random appointments with people who are not decision makers.



## What Counts as a Qualified Appointment



An appointment counts as qualified only if:



* You spoke with the owner or decision maker

* The business is a plumbing company or relevant home service business

* The owner is interested in missed-call or after-hours call capture

* The owner understands why the meeting is being booked

* The appointment is added to the calendar

* The owner receives a confirmation message

* CRM notes are fully completed

* The prospect is not fake, spam, or unable to make decisions



A random “call me later” does not count as a qualified appointment.



## Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Making outbound calls to U.S. local businesses

* Asking for the owner or decision maker

* Following the provided script

* Asking about missed calls, after-hours calls, voi
, and answering services

* Finding out if the business has a problem with missed calls or slow follow-up

* Booking qualified appointments on the calendar

* Sending appointment confirmation messages

* Taking clear notes in the CRM

* Updating lead status after every call

* Creating follow-up tasks for interested prospects

* Sending a daily activity report



## Example Call Script



You will be trained on a script like this:



“Hey, is this {{Business Name}}?”



“Awesome, is the owner around?”



When speaking with the owner:



“Hey {{Owner Name}}, this is {{Your Name}}. Quick question — when someone calls after-hours for an emergency plumbing job, does that go to a live person, voi
, or an answering service?”



If they answer:



“Got it. The reason I’m calling is we help plumbing companies capture missed and after-hours calls so they can turn more of those calls into booked jobs instead of losing them to voi
. Would it be crazy to have Maxx take 15 minutes to show you how it works?”



If they already use an answering service:



“That makes sense. Are they actually booking jobs into your calendar, or mostly just taking messages?”



If interested:



“Perfect. Maxx can show you how the missed-call revenue system works. Does tomorrow at {{time}} or {{time}} work better?”



## Required CRM Notes



For every real conversation, you must enter notes in the CRM.



Notes must include:



* Business name

* Owner or decision maker name

* Phone number

* Current call handling process

* Whether they miss calls

* What happens after-hours

* Whether they use voi
, office staff, or answering service

* Pain points mentioned

* Interest level

* Appointment date and time

* Confirmation status

* Objections or special notes



If there are no notes, the appointment may not count.



## Required Skills



You must have:



* Strong spoken English

* Confident phone voice

* Cold calling experience

* Ability to handle rejection

* Ability to follow a script

* Good note-taking skills

* Reliable internet

* Quiet work environment

* Headset or clear microphone

* Ability to work during U.S. business hours

* Fast response time

* Strong work ethic

* Ability to make consistent outbound calls



## Preferred Experience



Preferred but not required:



* B2B cold calling experience

* Appointment setting experience

* Experience calling local businesses

* Experience with GoHighLevel, Close, HubSpot, Salesforce, or other CRMs

* Experience selling marketing, software, lead generation, or appointment setting services

* Experience calling home service businesses



## Work Schedule



You must be available to call during U.S. business hours.



Preferred calling windows:



Monday through Friday

8:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. time zones



You may be calling businesses in Eastern, Central, Mountain, and Pacific time zones.



## Tracking and Accountability



All calls must be tracked inside our CRM.



We track:



* Dials

* Conversations

* Decision makers reached

* Follow-ups created

* Qualified appointments booked

* Appointments confirmed

* Appointments that show

* Closed clients



If calls are not logged in the CRM, they do not count.



## Daily Report



At the end of each workday, you must send a daily report with:



* Total dials

* Total conversations

* Decision makers reached

* Follow-ups created

* Appointments booked

* Appointments confirmed

* Best lead notes

* Main objections heard

* Any issues or questions



## Application Instructions



To apply, please send:



1. A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself

2. Your cold calling experience

3. Your appointment setting experience

4. Your available work schedule in U.S. time zones

5. Your internet speed screenshot

6. Your headset/microphone setup

7. The most outbound calls you have made in one day

8. A short answer to this question:



“What would you say if a plumbing business owner says, ‘We already have someone answering calls’?”



## Test Script



Please record yourself saying this:



“Hey, is this {{Business Name}}? Awesome, is the owner around?”



Then:



“Hey {{Owner Name}}, this is {{Your Name}}. Quick question — when someone calls after-hours for an emergency plumbing job, does that go to a live person, voi
, or an answering service?”



## Final Note



We are looking for someone reliable, coachable, and consistent. This role includes hourly pay and performance bonuses. If you can make calls, follow the script, book quality appointments, and keep accurate CRM notes, there is a strong opportunity to grow with us.

title: AU Payroll Admin | Morning Shift + Statutory Benefits
description:
Job Brief  



????We are seeking a highly organised and detail-oriented Payroll Administrator to manage end-to-end payroll operations and financial administration for a growing Australian business. This role is responsible for ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time while maintaining compliance with Australian payroll legislation, modern awards, and statutory reporting requirements. 

Working closely with finance, operations, and management teams, the successful candidate will oversee payroll processing, leave management, accounts administration, and payroll compliance activities. This position is ideally suited to a payroll professional who thrives in a deadline-driven environment and takes pride in accuracy, confidentiality, and process improvement. 



Responsibilities 

Payroll Processing: Manage weekly payroll processing within MYOB, ensuring accurate calculations, timely payments, and distribution of payslips. 

Timesheet Validation: Review and validate employee timesheets, allowances, overtime, leave requests, and payroll inputs to ensure accuracy and compliance. 

Leave Management: Process and reconcile annual leave, personal leave, and other employee entitlements while maintaining accurate leave balances. 

Employee Records Management: Maintain payroll records including new employee onboarding, terminations, salary adjustments, deductions, and employee data updates. 

Payroll Calculations: Ensure accurate processing of PAYG withholding, superannuation, salary sacrifice arrangements, allowances, overtime, and other payroll obligations. 

Payroll Enquiries: Respond to payroll-related enquiries from employees and managers in a professional and timely manner. 

Trade Workforce Payroll: Process trade-based payroll transactions, including timesheets, allowances, and overtime calculations across multiple business divisions. 

Award Interpretation: Assist with the interpretation and application of modern awards, enterprise agreements, and employment conditions. 

Compliance Reporting: Manage payroll compliance requirements including Single Touch Payroll (STP), LeavePlus reporting, and year-end payroll reconciliations. 

Liability Reconciliation: Reconcile payroll-related liabilities including superannuation contributions, PAYG withholding payments, and statutory obligations. 

Statutory Administration: Prepare and process monthly statutory declarations and related compliance documentation. 

Expense Management: Process employee expenses and maintain accurate expense records and reporting spreadsheets. 

Accounts Receivable: Allocate incoming payments, reconcile customer accounts, and investigate payment discrepancies. 

Supplier Payments: Prepare payment runs and ensure supplier invoices are paid in accordance with agreed trading terms. 

Invoice Processing: Process supplier invoices within Simpro, ensuring correct matching against purchase orders, approvals, and supporting documentation. 

Project Coordination: Liaise with Project Managers regarding unmatched purchase orders, invoice approvals, and outstanding financial items. 

Discrepancy Resolution: Investigate and resolve inconsistencies between invoices, purchase orders, and receiving documentation. 

MYOB Administration: Enter company expenses into MYOB and maintain accurate digital records with supporting invoice attachments. 

Statement Reconciliation: Reconcile supplier statements, bank accounts, and financial records within MYOB. 

Financial Reporting: Prepare daily cash reports, accounts payable reports, and other financial reports required by management. 



Requirements 

Proven experience as a Payroll Administrator supporting Australian businesses, preferably within construction, trades, air conditioning, or related industries.  

Extensive experience processing payroll using MYOB.  

Strong understanding of Australian payroll legislation, compliance requirements, and modern award interpretation.  

Experience with Single Touch Payroll (STP), PAYG withholding, superannuation, LeavePlus reporting, and year-end payroll processes.  

Strong familiarity with Simpro for timesheet processing, job costing, purchase orders, and invoice management.  

High level of numerical accuracy and exceptional attention to detail.  

Strong verbal and written English communication skills aligned with Australian professional standards.  

Ability to manage strict payroll deadlines and prioritise multiple responsibilities effectively.  

Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive employee and financial information.  



Software Proficiency 

Payroll & Accounting Software – MYOB 

Job Management Software – Simpro 

Productivity Tools – Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office Suite 



Education 

Bachelor’s Degree in Accountancy, Finance, Human Resource Management, Business Administration, or a related field. 



Time Zone: Australian Business Hours 

Applicant Location: Must be located in the Philippines

title: Amazon PPC Manager – E-commerce Growth & ROI Specialist
description:
Role Overview: We are seeking a highly analytical, aggressive, and results-driven Amazon PPC Manager to take full ownership of our Amazon advertising strategy and execution. In this role, you will not just be "managing campaigns"—you will be the driving force behind our profitability, revenue scaling, and market share domination.



We are looking for a strategic expert with a proven, verifiable track record of scaling Amazon brands while lowering Total Advertising Cost of Sales (TACoS) and maximizing Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). If you are a problem-solver who thrives on data, scaling budgets profitably, and measurable outcomes, we want to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities (What You Will Accomplish):



Drive Scalable Revenue Growth: Architect, launch, and aggressively manage full-funnel Amazon advertising campaigns (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and Amazon DSP) to maximize daily sales velocity and net profit.

Relentless Optimization: Continuously audit and optimize bids, search terms, and targeting strategies to achieve aggressive target ACoS and TACoS. You will cut wasted spend with precision negative keywords while scaling winning campaigns.

Keyword & Competitor Domination: Execute deep-dive keyword research and competitor analysis to identify profitable gaps, win top-of-search placements, and aggressively defend our brand share against competitors.

Strategic Campaign Architecture: Build and refine advanced campaign structures (e.g., search term isolation, auto-campaign harvesting, and custom budget allocation based on product life cycles and profitability).

Actionable Reporting & Forecasting: Go beyond basic metrics. Deliver weekly performance insights detailing critical KPIs (Spend, Sales, ROAS, ACoS, TACoS, CTR, CVR) accompanied by proactive action plans and growth forecasts.

Inventory Alignment: Collaborate closely with the inventory team to align ad spend with stock levels—aggressively pushing overstock inventory while throttling or pausing campaigns to avoid stockouts on top-sellers.

A/B Testing & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Continuously test ad copy, custom creative assets, video ads, and storefront traffic to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) and overall Conversion Rates (CVR).





Required Skills & Qualifications:



Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience independently managing high-volume Amazon PPC budgets ($50k - $100k+/month spend).

Proven Track Record: Tangible history of scaling accounts while maintaining or improving profitability targets. (Note: You will be required to share your best case studies).

Technical Mastery: Deep, up-to-date understanding of the Amazon A9 Ranking Algorithm, Amazon Campaign Manager, Brand Analytics, and advanced targeting features.

Strategic Mindset: Proactive problem-solver who does not wait to be told what to do. You stay ahead of Amazon’s frequent platform updates and terms of service changes.





Performance KPIs (How Your Success Will Be Measured):



Overall Revenue Growth at the brand level.

Strict adherence to benchmark TACoS (Total ACoS) and target ROAS.

Increased organic ranking velocity driven by targeted PPC conversions.

Reduction of wasted ad spend (Zero-sale search term mitigation).





Compensation & Perks:



Pay Rate: HIGHLY NEGOTIABLE. We believe in paying top dollar for top talent. Compensation will be tailored to your experience, direct track record, and the results you can deliver. We are open to a strong base salary, performance-based profit-sharing, or commission structures for the right A-player.



Fully remote work environment with flexible working hours.



Opportunity to lead growth for an ambitious and rapidly expanding brand.



How to Apply: Please submit your resume along with a brief cover letter. With your application, you must include your best case studies detailing your past performance (e.g., how you successfully scaled an account, improved ROAS/ACoS, and the specific strategies you implemented to achieve those results).

title: Video Editor — NYC Creative Agency | Real Projects, Real Budgets, Room to Grow
description:
About Us (
)

Mixson Media is a Brooklyn-based creative agency specializing in event coverage, brand videography, weddings, corporate content, vlogs, and cinematic storytelling. We work with schools, nonprofits, corporate clients, and personal brands across New York City. Our work is cinematic, community-driven, and built around authentic storytelling — not cookie-cutter templates.



The founder and owner of Mixson Media is himself a professional videographer and editor with years of experience shooting and cutting real projects at a high level. This is not a business owner who saw a YouTube tutorial and thinks they understand editing. This is a working creative who knows exactly what great footage looks like, what great shot selection feels like, and what a finished product needs to be. That means the bar is high — and it also means you'll be learning from someone who can actually teach you and push your craft forward.



We're growing fast and we need an editor who wants to grow with us.





The Opportunity

This is not a one-off gig. This is the beginning of a long-term role.



We're building out our editing pipeline and looking for a primary editor to start on a per-project basis with a clear path to a full salaried position within six months. The projects you'll be working on have real budgets, real clients, and real deadlines — including weddings, corporate events, travel content, and brand campaigns that most editors at this level never get access to.



If you're coachable, love the craft, and want to grow inside a real creative operation — this is the opportunity you've been looking for.





What You'll Be Editing

Weddings and large-scale events (galas, graduations, corporate events)

Event highlight reels for schools and nonprofits

Vlogs, behind-the-scenes, and travel content

Cinematic short films and storytelling pieces

Sporting events





Pay Structure

Pay is per project. Rates scale with project complexity — the base rates below are the floor, not the ceiling. Weddings, travel projects, and large-scale productions pay significantly more.



Base Editing Rates (starting at):



$75 per finished minute of edited content

$15 per hour of footage sifted and organized



What that looks like in practice:



A 3-minute event highlight reel = $225+ editing pay

A 5-minute wedding highlight film = $375+ (more for complex multi-camera, long-form projects)

Travel and destination content = negotiated per project, always above base rate

Consistent work from day one — this is not a "wait for jobs to come in" situation



Growth path:



Months 1-3: Per-project basis as you learn the style and workflow

Months 4-6: Increased volume and project complexity

Month 6+: Full salaried position at $2,000-$3,000/month based on performance





What We're Looking For

Required:



Proficiency in DaVinci Resolve (non-negotiable — we do not use Premiere Pro)

Strong shot selection — you understand why one clip works and another doesn't

Basic to intermediate color grading — clean, consistent, cinematic

Sound design at a working level (7/10 minimum) — dialogue clarity, music balance, ambient fill 

Basic motion graphics — lower thirds, text overlays, simple transitions

Ability to take direction and match an established style

Reliable turnaround — deadlines are not suggestions



Preferred:



Experience editing weddings, events, or travel content

Familiarity with cinematic editing styles beyond quick social cuts

Experience working with LOG footage and color science



Most Important: You love editing. Not as a job — as a craft. You watch great content and study why it works. You have opinions about shot selection. You want to get better and you're willing to be coached to get there.





What This Is NOT

This is not a passive gig where you edit however you want

This is not for editors who want to impose their own style over the project

This is not for editors who can't take feedback or direction

This is not for editors who disappear after taking a project





How to Apply

We receive a lot of applications. To make sure we're connecting with people who are serious, here's what we need from you:



Step 1 — Record a short Loom video (2-3 minutes max)



Go to loom.com, record yourself on camera, and answer these three questions:



Who are you, what kind of content do you love editing, and why do you want this role specifically?

Walk us through one edit you're proud of — show us the finished product and tell us what decisions you made and why.

What's your current skill level in DaVinci Resolve and what are you actively working to get better at?



Don't overthink it. Don't script it. Just talk to us like a real person.



Step 2 — Send the following to 



Your Loom video link

A link to your reel or 2-3 work samples

Your typical turnaround time for a 3-minute edit

Subject line: EDITOR APPLICATION — [Your Name]



Send everything to: 



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered. This is the filter. If you can't take 3 minutes to show us who you are, we're not the right fit for each other.



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid test edit — raw footage and a style reference provided. We pay for your time even on the test.



I understand this might be a lot, that's the point we're trying to help someone become ELITE









Mixson Media Inc — Brooklyn, NY | Remote editing role | Long-term opportunity

We are seeking a highly motivated, professional, and personable Phone Customer Service Representative to join our team. The ideal candidate has excellent spoken English, a neutral or American/British accent, and strong communication skills. This role is primarily focused on speaking with customers and partners over the phone, providing support, handling inquiries, coordinating with vendors, and helping ensure a smooth customer experience. The right person should be organized, adaptable, calm under pressure, and comfortable managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.



Key Responsibilities:



- Answer inbound and make outbound calls to customers, vendors, and partners.

- Provide a high level of customer service and maintain a professional, friendly tone on every call.

- Assist customers with questions, updates, and issue resolution.

- Coordinate with vendors, partners, and internal tea
mbers to help move orders and requests forward.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and partners.

- Accurately enter data and maintain records in internal systems.

- Conduct online research when needed to gather relevant information.

- Handle multiple ongoing tasks efficiently while staying organized and detail-oriented.

- Work closely with the team to ensure smooth day-to-day operations.



Qualifications:



-Previous experience in a BPO, call center, or phone-based customer service role is required.

-Excellent verbal communication skills with a neutral or American/British English accent.

-Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport quickly over the phone.

-Confident, clear, and professional speaking style.

-Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

-Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

-Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently.

-Reliable internet connection and a quiet work environment.



Work Schedule:



Full-time, US Eastern Time hours

Exact schedule to be discussed.



Application Instructions:



To apply, please submit your CV and record a short video of yourself answering the following questions. Please do your best using a clear US accent:



1. How many clients do you currently have, and how many hours per week do you work with them?

2. We’re looking for someone to work US hours. Does that work for you?

3. What interested you in this position, and what are you looking for in your next opportunity?

4. Do you consider yourself an entrepreneur? Why? If yes, please give an example.

5. Do you consider yourself a risk taker? Why? If yes, please explain.

6. Do you consider yourself hardworking? If yes, please share an example that shows your work ethic.

7. What motivates you most in life, and why?

8. Which do you value more: money or growth? Why?

9. Describe one of your favorite clients/jobs. Why were they your favorite?

10. What is one of the biggest challenges you’ve overcome in your life?

11. Is there anything else you think we should know about you?



Please note: applications without the video described above will not be considered.



We look forward to hearing from you.

description:

title: Real Estate Research Assistant
description:
About the Role

•We are looking for a detail-oriented property researcher to help identify land parcels in the United States that may fit specific acquisition criteria.

•This role requires strong web research skills, comfort using county GIS maps, attention to zoning and parcel details, and accurate Excel or Google Sheets work.

•You  need to be reliable, organized, and able to follow detailed instructions.



Primary Responsibilities

•Research land parcels using LandID, county GIS maps, assessor records, property appraiser websites, zoning maps, planning department websites, and other public sources. (I will teach how to use LandID software if you have not used it).

•Identify parcels that match specific search criteria such as acreage, zoning, road access, topography, wetlands, nearby development, utilities, and current listing status.

•Enter parcel data into Excel or Google Sheets using a required format.

•Record parcel number, owner name, owner mailing address, site address, acreage, zoning, land use, road access, nearby projects, notes, and source links.

•Review GIS maps to check parcel boundaries, roads, nearby subdivisions, utilities, floodplain/wetland indicators, and surrounding development patterns.

•Check whether a property appears to be currently listed for sale and exclude listed properties when instructed.

•Organize findings clearly so another person can quickly verify the parcel.

•Flag uncertain items instead of guessing.



Required Skills

•Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including sorting, filtering, formatting, hyperlinks, and clean data entry.

•Ability to use online GIS maps and parcel viewers.

•Ability to research zoning and land use information from county or city websites.

•Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

•Comfort working with U.S. property records and public data websites.

•Ability to follow written instructions exactly.

•Good written English for notes, summaries, and questions.

•Reliable internet connection and ability to meet deadlines.



Helpful Experience

•Real estate research, land research, title research, GIS research, zoning research, or property data entry.

•Experience with county assessor websites, planning and zoning maps, GIS parcel viewers, Google Earth, FEMA maps, or listing websites.

•Experience researching agricultural land, development land, vacant land, or residential growth areas.

•Experience checking roads, utilities, wetlands, floodplain, slope, and nearby residential development.

Typical Parcel Criteria You May Research

•20 or more acres.

•Relatively flat land or limited topographical change.

•At least two possible road access points when available.

•No major wetlands on the usable portion of the property.

•Agricultural, rural residential, transition, or similar zoning.

title: Backend Operations Manager Shopify Stores | Disputes, Supply Chain & CS (Long-Term, Full-Time)
description:
We're a fast-growing e-commerce group operating 16–30 Shopify stores across multiple legal entities. We work with a dedicated fulfillment partner (DayOne) and an external advertising agency  running Google Shopping at scale. Our volume sits at 100+ disputes per week across Shopify Payments, PayPal, and Whop, plus daily supplier coordination, customer service oversight, and agency communication via Slack.

We're not a side hustle. This is a serious operation, and we're building it like one.



What we're hiring for:

We're looking for a Backend Operations Manager — a true A-player who can take the operational weight off the founder's shoulders. You will own the day-to-day backend of the business: disputes, chargebacks, supply chain, customer service, and partner communication. If you've ever felt like you were carrying a whole company on your back and want a place that rewards that — we want to talk.



What you'll own (of course, we have teams with employees and managers in each department, but you will be ultimately responsible for all departments):



Disputes & Chargebacks (~40% of role)

* Manage 100+ disputes per week across Shopify Payments, PayPal, and Whop

* Build and execute evidence packages following our internal SOPs

* Track win rates per processor, per store, per reason code

* Identify patterns (fraud rings, recurring chargeback reasons) and flag them upstream

* Coordinate with PayPal/Stripe support when escalations are needed



Supply Chain & Supplier Coordination (~25%)

* Daily communication with our fulfillment partner (DayOne) via Slack

* Verify supplier invoices against our internal quote sheet (Empire X DayOne)

* Flag discrepancies, missing SKUs, pricing mismatches

* Track shipping issues, lost packages, returns

* Coordinate inventory questions across multiple stores/entities



Customer Service Oversight (~20%)

* Manage CS workflows across our store portfolio

* Handle escalations that frontline agents can't resolve

* Spot recurring issues and turn them into process improvements

* Keep response-time SLAs in check



Who you are

This is a backend manager role, not a VA role. We're looking for someone who:

- Has run operations for multi-store Shopify or DTC businesses before (not just one store)

- Has serious experience with PayPal disputes and Shopify Payments chargebacks at volume — you know what "compelling evidence" actually means and which arguments win

- Has worked with fulfillment partners and knows how to read an invoice critically

- Communicates in clear, professional English — written and spoken

- Lives in Slack comfortably and can hold structured conversations across multiple channels

- Is proactive — you don't wait to be told what to do, you spot problems and propose fixes

- Is calm under volume — 100+ disputes a week doesn't faze you

- Owns outcomes, not tasks



Must-haves:

- 3+ years managing operations for an e-commerce business (Shopify preferred)

- Hands-on experience defending chargebacks (Shopify Payments AND PayPal — not just one)

- Comfortable working with multiple legal entities, multiple stores, multiple payment processors

- Excellent written English

- Self-managed — full-time available, reliable internet, professional setup

- Available full-time (50 hrs/week), long-term commitment



Nice-to-haves

+ Experience with Whop disputes

+ Familiarity with Google Shopping feeds (Simprosys, Multifeeds, Pythago)

+ Experience working with external ad agencies

+ Background in fashion / branded DTC

+ Process documentation experience (writing SOPs, training others)

+ Comfort working with AI tools (we're heavily AI-augmented and will give you serious AI leverage)



What we offer:

+ Long-term, full-time role — we're hiring for years, not weeks

+ Competitive rate based on experience (range: $12–20/hr, open to higher for the right person)

+ Real ownership — you'll be the backend, not just a task-taker

+ AI leverage — we build AI agents to do the repetitive work so you can focus on judgment calls

+ Growth path — as we scale to 50+ stores and a $100M brand portfolio, this role grows with us

+ Direct access to the founder — no middle layers, no politics, no nonsense



How to apply

We get a lot of templated applications. Here's how to make sure we read yours:

Start your cover letter with the word "EMPIRE" so we know you actually read this post.

Then, in your application, briefly tell us:



- How many Shopify stores have you managed simultaneously, and which payment processors did they use?

- What's the highest dispute/chargeback volume you've handled in a single week? What was your win rate?

- Tell us about a time you caught a supplier invoice error. What was the discrepancy and how much did you save?

- What's your timezone, and what hours can you commit to overlapping with CET (Netherlands)?

- Why this role specifically — what about it fits where you want to go in the next 2–3 years?



Applications without these answers will not be reviewed.

title: IT Service Manager
description:
About Us



At MG|Computer, we’re the MSP companies call when uptime isn’t optional. Our clients demand fast, reliable IT — and we deliver. We don’t just fix problems; we anticipate them, prevent them, and turn technology into a business advantage.



The Role



We’re looking for a battle-tested IT Service Manager who thrives in the high-pressure, high-stakes MSP environment. If you know what it’s like to balance 100+ open tickets, handle demanding clients, and still keep your team sharp, calm, and accountable — you’re the kind of leader we need.



This is not a cushy corporate IT role. This is an MSP leadership role: unpredictable, fast-paced, and client-driven. Your job is to keep the service desk humming, ensure SLA compliance, manage escalations, and lead a team that’s always on point.



What You’ll Do



Own the service desk — ensuring SLAs are met, escalations are resolved, and clients are satisfied.



Lead, coach, and hold accountable a team of L1–L3 engineers. You’ll know when to push, when to support, and when to jump in yourself.



Manage ticket flow like an air traffic controller — balancing client demands, team capacity, and urgency without dropping the ball.



Report and act on key MSP metrics: response times, resolution rates, SLA compliance, and client satisfaction.



Enforce process discipline while finding smarter, faster, automated ways to work.



Build trust with clients — stepping in when the heat is on and making sure they know we’ve got their back.



Coordinate with project and vCIO/account teams to ensure support and strategy align.



What You Bring



Proven MSP experience – you’ve managed a service desk in an MSP and know the pace, the pressure, and the reward.



Strong leadership skills — you can get results from techs without burning them out.



Hands-on technical depth in Microsoft 365, Azure, networking, and security — you know when to step in and when to delegate.



Expertise with PSA/RMM tools (ConnectWise, Autotask, Kaseya, N-able, etc.).



Ability to calm clients in crisis and confidently manage escalations.



ITIL knowledge/certifications a plus, but street-smart MSP experience is just as valuable.



Why This Role?



Competitive salary + performance incentives for hitting KPIs.



High visibility and leadership within a fast-growing MSP.



Work with a team that’s been in the trenches and knows what it takes.



Opportunities to shape process, scale operations, and lead real change.



???? Ready to Lead?

If you’ve managed an MSP service desk under pressure and know how to balance people, process, and client expectations — we want to talk to you.

Firm Five is a fast-growing, CPA-led accounting and controllership firm serving clients across Canada and the United States.

Remote

Flexible hours

We are seeking an experienced Sage Intacct consultant who has successfully completed QuickBooks-to-Intacct migrations and implementations.

This role will support our accounting and controller teams on client migration projects, particularly for multi-entity organizations with complex reporting requirements.



Responsibilities:

Lead or support Sage Intacct implementations

Design multi-entity structures within Sage Intacct

Build charts of accounts and dimensional reporting frameworks

Migrate historical data from QuickBooks Desktop and QuickBooks Online

Multi-entity accounting

Consolidations

Intercompany transactions

Dimensions and reporting structures

multi-location business experience

Resume

title: Executive Assistant / VA / Operations / Social Media
description:
About The Role



We are seeking a brilliant, high-autonomy Executive Assistant & Operations Coordinator to serve as the internal engine of our growing business. This is not a standard data-entry or purely administrative role. You will act as the right-hand operator to the Executive, taking ownership of our internal operations, back-end tech infrastructure, team accountability, and social media execution.



Your mission is to handle the day-to-day execution and optimization so the Executive can focus entirely on high-level strategy and client growth. We heavily leverage AI (specifically Claude) and automation, and we want someone who will proactively find better, faster ways to scale our processes.



Key Responsibilities



 Internal Operations & Tech Infrastructure

Maintain, audit, and optimize our core operational tracking and content management systems (primarily built within Google Workspace: Drive, Docs, Sheets).

Research, recommend, and lead the implementation of new lean tech tools and no-code automations (e.g., Zapier, Make.com) to streamline workflows.

Document Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) based on video walkthroughs (e.g., Loom) and continually look for ways to optimize them using AI agents.

 Backend Social Media & Scale Management

Technical setup, provisioning, and ongoing management of multiple internal and specific project-related social media accounts (handling back-end configurations, security, and profile warming).

Execute the formatting, AI-driven optimization (using Claude), and scheduling/posting of content across various profiles at scale.

Track industry news, trends, and algorithm updates daily, flagging critical changes to the Executive.

 Team Accountability & Reporting

Act as the Executive’s proxy to follow up with internal team members, ensuring deadlines are met and deliverables are accurate.

Gather raw monthly data across various accounts, plug them into Google Workspace trackers, and utilize Claude/AI to draft clean, insightful performance reports for executive review.

 Executive & Personal Support

Manage a variety of ad-hoc personal tasks for the Executive, including lifestyle research (vacations, vehicles, personal bookings, etc.).

Protect the Executive’s time by filtering information and proactively solving operational bottlenecks before they escalate.



Required Qualifications



Education: Bachelor’s Degree (BA/BS) required (Business, Communications, or IT backgrounds preferred).

Language: Immaculate, near-native written and spoken English.

AI Literacy: Demonstrated experience using Claude or ChatGPT for text formatting, data analysis, prompting, and workflow acceleration.

Autonomy: A proven "one-instruction" worker. You can watch a quick training video, replicate the task perfectly, and build a process around it without requiring micromanagement.

Reliability: Highly organized with a proactive mindset—you anticipate needs and fix inefficiencies before being asked.

title: Part-Time Taglish B2B Caller / Appointment Setter — Healthcare  (2-Week Paid Pilot)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

  I'm an independent analyst offering Philippine dialysis centers

  a FREE check of the PhilHealth claims they can still recover

  before the 60-day refiling deadline closes. I need a warm,

  professional Taglish-speaking caller to phone and Viber about

  100 centers, explain the free offer, and book short intro calls

  for me (or get a simple data export). This is a PAID 2-week

  pilot (~4 hours/day, weekdays). Strong performance can extend

  into ongoing work.



  WHAT YOU'LL DO

  - Call + Viber dialysis centers from a list I provide

  (NCR/Luzon).

  - Reach the owner or the billing/PhilHealth person, deliver a

  short scripted pitch, and handle basic objections ("Is this a

  scam?", "How much?").

  - Book a 15-minute call with me, or get them to agree to send a

  de-identified data export (no patient data).

  - Log every outcome in a shared Google Sheet.



  YOU MUST HAVE

  - Fluent Taglish and a clear, friendly phone voice; comfortable

  talking to clinic owners/doctors.

  - B2B phone / telemarketing / appointment-setting experience

  (please give examples).

  - Your own smartphone with a registered SIM, Viber, a headset, a

  quiet space, and stable internet.

  - Honesty and professionalism — you'll follow strict rules:

  always identify yourself truthfully, offer an opt-out, never

  promise a specific peso amount, never ask for patient data or

  payment, and never record a call without consent.

  - Reliable daily reporting.



  NICE TO HAVE

  - Healthcare / medical-billing / PhilHealth / insurance

  background; familiarity with clinics.



  SCHEDULE & PAY

  ~4 hours/day, weekdays, mid-morning to afternoon, for ~2 weeks.

  ?450/hour (negotiable by experience) + ?300 bonus per qualified

  booked call. Paid weekly via PayPal (Wise/GCash possible).



  HOW TO APPLY (please follow — applications that skip this are

  set aside)

  In your application, include:

  1) Your B2B calling experience (what you sold, how you got past

  gatekeepers).

  2) The SIM/phone and internet speed you'd use, and your

  availability for the next 2 weeks.

  3) A LINK to a 1-minute Taglish voice recording (use Vocaroo.com

  or Google Drive) where you pretend to call a dialysis-center

  owner about "a free check on PhilHealth claims you can still

  recover." This voice clip is your audition — be natural and

  warm.

title: Video editor
description:
Part-Time Video Editor Needed (Fitness Content)



I'm an online fitness coach focused on helping Latinos lose fat, build muscle, and create a healthier lifestyle without giving up their culture or favorite foods.



I'm looking for a video editor who can edit with SPEED while maintaining QUALITY.



This is not a super flashy editing role.



I'm looking for someone who understands clean, engaging content that keeps viewers watching.



## What You'll Be Doing



? Editing short-form content (Instagram Reels, TikTok, Shorts)



? Adding clean subtitles/captions



? Smooth cuts and transitions



? Adding relevant B-roll footage when needed



? Following scripts and editing instructions



? Organizing files through Google Drive and shared folders



? Maintaining clear and consistent communication



## What I'm Looking For



* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable communication

* Ability to follow instructions

* Fast turnaround times

* Experience editing short-form social media content

* Familiar with fitness, nutrition, or lifestyle content (preferred but not required)



## Editing Style



I am NOT looking for over-the-top edits.



Think:



* Clean

* Engaging

* Easy to watch

* Good pacing

* Professional subtitles

* Strategic B-roll

* Smooth viewing experience



To understand the style I'm aiming for, check out:







Creator 



Especially pay attention to the food-related content style.



## Position Details



* Part-time

* Per-video opportunities available

* Flexible workload initially



As content volume increases, there is potential for more consistent work and additional editing opportunities.



## To Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio or sample edits

2. Your editing software of choice

3. Your turnaround time for a 30-60 second reel

4. Your rate (per video or hourly)

5. The word "Protein" at the beginning of your application so I know you read the entire post



### Test Edit Requirement



Applicants selected for the next step will be asked to complete a short 20-30 second test edit.



A portfolio shows what you've done.



A test edit shows what you'll do for me.



This helps ensure we're a good fit before moving forward.



Bonus points if you've edited fitness, nutrition, food, or coaching content before.
